TextContext.SourceString: （乌尔比诺联盟总部，大会议室。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Urbino HQ, Conference Room.)

TextContext.SourceString: （足以容纳上百人的大型会议室，此时却显得嘈杂不堪。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The grand conference room fills with chattering.)

TextContext.SourceString: 你听说了吗？那件事是真的吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Have you heard? Are the rumors true?

TextContext.SourceString: 啊？你是说理事会要求奥黛丽卸任常任理事的事？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Eh? You mean the board asking Audrey to step down as permanent director?

TextContext.SourceString: 嘘、嘘……！小点声！那可是那个“钢铁的独角兽”……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Shh... shh! Not so loud! Don't forget, that's the “Steel Unicorn” we're talking about...

TextContext.SourceString: 被她听到这种议论，我们可没有好果子吃……
TextContext.LocalizedString: If she gets wind of this, it's going to be trouble for us, too...

TextContext.SourceString: 怕什么，你没听过传闻吗？说她得了崩溃症，早忘了以前的事了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: What are you worried about? Haven't you heard? They say she's fallen ill with collapse syndrome. She doesn't remember anything from the past.

TextContext.SourceString: 现在的她，哼，不过就是个啥都不懂的小姑娘罢了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hmpf! Now she's nothing but a young girl without a clue about anything.

TextContext.SourceString: 肃静，肃静！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Silence, silence!

TextContext.SourceString: 接下来，理事会将召开关于格罗夫银行事件的听证会。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Next on the agenda, the Grove Bank incident.

TextContext.SourceString: 奥黛丽小姐——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Lady Audrey...

TextContext.SourceString: （会议室的大门洞开，无数的、刀剑一般的目光唰地一声向出现在那里的人影看去。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The door to the conference room opens, and countless eyes stare daggers into the figure who walks in.)

TextContext.SourceString: 失礼了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Excuse me.

TextContext.SourceString: （奥黛丽的声音随着她的脚步一同，迎着众人的目光，毅然地踏入这无形的荆棘之中。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Audrey's voice follows her footsteps, treading with conviction into a sea of thorns.)

TextContext.SourceString: （在她的正对面，是乌尔比诺五位常任理事成员的坐席。但现在，只有三位成员高坐其上。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Directly opposite of her are the seats of Urbino's five permanent directors, but now, only three of them are occupied.)

TextContext.SourceString: （空置的一张椅子，原本是属于她的位置。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (One of those vacant chairs was originally hers.)

TextContext.SourceString: （如今，奥黛丽却站在它的对面，接受着它的审判。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Audrey now stands on the other side, accepting its judgment.)

TextContext.SourceString: 奥黛丽小姐，关于日前发生在格罗夫银行的事件……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Lady Audrey, regarding what happened at Grove Bank...

TextContext.SourceString: 我们由衷地为您感到遗憾。
TextContext.LocalizedString: We would like to express our deepest sympathies.

TextContext.SourceString: “格罗夫集团在这次事件中首当其冲”，受到……呵……“不明的反乌尔比诺势力的攻击。”
TextContext.LocalizedString: “Grove Enterprises bore the brunt of these attacks from... ah... “unknown anti-Urbino forces...”

TextContext.SourceString: “在付出巨大的代价后成功挫败了敌人的阴谋，保护了乌尔比诺成员的重要财产。”
TextContext.LocalizedString: “But they successfully foiled the enemy's plans and protected the key assets of Urbino members at great cost.”

TextContext.SourceString: 这就是您在报告书上提交的事件报告，奥黛丽小姐。
TextContext.LocalizedString: This is the incident report that you filed, Lady Audrey.

TextContext.SourceString: 听起来，在座的各位还得感谢格罗夫集团——
TextContext.LocalizedString: It sounds like everyone here owes Grove Enterprises their thanks...

TextContext.SourceString: 让乌尔比诺的市值在一个月内蒸发了200个亿？
TextContext.LocalizedString: For allowing 20 billion in market value to evaporate in the span of a month?

TextContext.SourceString: 身为常任理事之一，格罗夫集团有必要对乌尔比诺全体的利益负责。
TextContext.LocalizedString: As a permanent member of the board, Grove Enterprises is responsible for protecting all of Urbino's interests.

TextContext.SourceString: 如果不是格罗夫在确定切特尼克成为乌尔比诺的全体安全承包商这件事上投了反对票，恐怕也不会有今天的事。
TextContext.LocalizedString: If Grove Enterprises didn't vote against confirming Cherrus Tactical as Urbino's security contractor, none of this would have happened.

TextContext.SourceString: 常任理事的担子，对奥黛丽小姐而言怕是太重了吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Perhaps the burden of the permanent director seat is too heavy a burden for you, Lady Audrey?

TextContext.SourceString: 此言差矣，我所知道的格罗夫集团是一家有担当的企业。
TextContext.LocalizedString: That's unfair. I know Grove Enterprises to be a responsible company.

TextContext.SourceString: 只要格罗夫能够担起责任、平息舆论，并且让出自家的市场份额弥补各家企业的利益损失，不就证明了格罗夫依旧配得上常任理事的位子吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: So long as Grove Enterprises can take responsibility, calm public sentiment, and properly compensate Urbino's members for their losses, there's no reason to talk about revoking their board seat.

TextContext.SourceString: （奥黛丽十分明白，此时的她甚至比身处那一天暴徒们的弹雨中更为危险。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Audrey knows very well that she's in far more danger right now than she ever was the day of the incident.)

TextContext.SourceString: （无论接受天价的赔偿要求还是卸任常任理事，都不是她能承担的后果。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Providing an outlandish compensation or resigning as permanent director... neither of these are consequences that she can bear.)

TextContext.SourceString: （在这令人窒息的迷宫之中，她真的能找到出路吗？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Is there any way out of this suffocating labyrinth?)

TextContext.SourceString: （没问题的，你做的到。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Don't worry. You can do it.)

TextContext.SourceString: （你是“奥黛丽·格罗夫”……你是“钢铁的独角兽”……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (You are “Audrey Grove...” the “Steel Unicorn.”)

TextContext.SourceString: （拉拢盟友，交换利益，必要的时候就用上狡诈和威慑……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Win allies, exchange favors, and use your cunning and intimidation when necessary...)

TextContext.SourceString: （就像“奥黛丽”一直以来做的那样……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Just like “Audrey” has always done...)

TextContext.SourceString: （抬起头，睁开眼，这是你的战场。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Keep your head high and open your eyes. This battlefield is yours.)

TextContext.SourceString: 哟，我迟到了吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yo, am I late?

TextContext.SourceString: （伴随一阵强劲的音乐，一个绿色的人影破门而入，在所有人的诧异中来到了会场中心。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Accompanied by booming music, a figure in green bursts through the door and makes his way to the center of the room.)
Bai Mo...!?

TextContext.SourceString: 好久不见啊奥黛丽，还有其它人也是！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Long time no see, Audrey. Oh, and all you guys, too!

TextContext.SourceString: 不好意思啊，刚才冲过头了，大家聊的这么热闹啊？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Sorry, I must have overdid it. Weren't you all in the middle of a lively discussion?

TextContext.SourceString: ……我很确信，会议时间已经通过正式渠道向白氏集团转达。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...I am certain that the meeting time has been formally communicated to the Bai Group.

TextContext.SourceString: 白大少爷今天倒是有兴致来参加我们这无聊的会议了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Mr. Bai, what brings you to this boring meeting of ours?

TextContext.SourceString: 就算白氏集团没有到场，常任理事也能通过多数表决推进议程，不需要劳您大驾。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The permanent directors are capable of advancing the agenda through voting in the absence of the Bai Group. You don't have to come here yourself.

TextContext.SourceString: 别这么说嘛~好歹我也是乌尔比诺的盟主不是？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh, come on. I'm still the leader of Urbino, aren't I?

TextContext.SourceString: 那么，不知道盟主大人对本次的议题有何高见？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Very well. Would you share your opinions on the topic of this session, Mr. Leader?

TextContext.SourceString: 啊，议题？什么议题？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Topic? What are you talking about?

TextContext.SourceString: 我要说的是更有趣的事——
TextContext.LocalizedString: I have more interesting things in mind...

TextContext.SourceString: 奥黛丽小姐？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Lady Audrey?

TextContext.SourceString: ——诶？怎么了吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Eh? What is it?

TextContext.SourceString: 那个，你一直皱着眉头……是遇到什么烦恼了吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You look troubled... Is everything okay?

TextContext.SourceString: 稍微……有点公司的事务。不用担心。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's just... company matters. Don't worry about me.

TextContext.SourceString: 奥黛丽小姐明明这么忙，还要亲自陪我们来见白先生，真是不好意思。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I know you're very busy, Lady Audrey. I'm sorry to have to drag you with us to meet with Mr. Bai.

TextContext.SourceString: 那个人，实在太捉摸不透了，我可不放心让你单独去见他。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I wasn't going to let you face that unpredictable man all by yourself.

TextContext.SourceString: 这不是还有我吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hey, I'm standing right there.

TextContext.SourceString: 别当我不存在啊。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Don't act as if I'm invisible.

TextContext.SourceString: 哼哼……引航者，你是另一个同样让我捉摸不透的人。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You... Navigator, you are yet another unpredictable person.

TextContext.SourceString: 我稍微有点犹豫是不是能把你当成普通人来看待。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm slightly hesitant about whether I should treat you as an ordinary person.

TextContext.SourceString: 有点高兴~
TextContext.LocalizedString: Happy to hear that.

TextContext.SourceString: 有点受伤……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Wow. That hurt...

TextContext.SourceString: 不管怎么说，前辈就是前辈嘛~
TextContext.LocalizedString: Anyway, you've been great, Navigator.

TextContext.SourceString: 星绘身边有这么让人信赖的人在，真让人羡慕……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I can't help but feel envious of Astierred, who has such a reliable friend by her side...

TextContext.SourceString: 不，那个……我没有别的意思哦？
TextContext.LocalizedString: No, I mean... Don't overthink it.

TextContext.SourceString: 别的意思是指？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What do you mean?

TextContext.SourceString: 咳咳，咳咳咳——我们快到了！你们最好做好心理准备。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ahem... We're here! Get ready.

TextContext.SourceString: （在走廊的尽头，奥黛丽叩响了门扉。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Having arrived at the end of the corridor, Audrey knocks on the door.)

TextContext.SourceString: （眼前这扇普通的大门，似乎与其他房间并无不同。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The ordinary door in front of us seems no different from the others.)

TextContext.SourceString: 直接进来吧！我腾不开手！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Come on in! I'm busy!

TextContext.SourceString: 那就失礼了，盟主阁下。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Excuse us, then, Mr. Leader.

TextContext.SourceString: （随着房门打开，一阵强劲的音乐立即穿透耳膜，直击大脑。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As the door is opened, a blast of loud music pierces my eardrums.)

TextContext.SourceString: （看来这间其貌不扬的房间早已做好了充分的隔音措施。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (It appears that this unassuming room is fully soundproofed.)

TextContext.SourceString: （而其原因，此刻就在房间的中央。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The reason for which lies in the center of the room.)

TextContext.SourceString: （在办公室的中央，一位身着街头装扮的青年正在跳舞机上随着音乐舞动。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (In the middle of the office, a young man in casual clothing is playing a dance arcade game.)

TextContext.SourceString: （时而起跳，时而双手交叉，又时而做出左右摩擦的动作。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Throughout the song, the man jumps, crosses his arms, and rubs his hands on both sides.)

TextContext.SourceString: （跳舞机的计分板上不断弹出惊人的连击数。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Astonishing combo numbers keep popping up on the scoreboard of the arcade machine.)

TextContext.SourceString: （看到如此情景的三人一时间都忘记了说话，一直等到音乐停止，跳舞机发出了刷新纪录的祝贺音效。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Captivated by the amazing performance, the three of us stand in silence until the arcade machine plays the congratulatory sound effect for setting a new record as the song comes to an end.)

TextContext.SourceString: （鼓掌）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (We applauded.)

TextContext.SourceString: 哈哈，果然艺术还是得有观众欣赏才行啊！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ha-ha. Art indeed requires an audience!

TextContext.SourceString: 真是令人印象深刻的舞蹈呢……
TextContext.LocalizedString: What an impressive dance...

TextContext.SourceString: 请问，白先生在哪里呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Excuse me, where can we find Mr. Bai?

TextContext.SourceString: ……容我介绍，这位神秘街舞男就是你们口中的白先生——白氏集团的总裁、乌尔比诺商业联盟的盟主，白墨。
TextContext.LocalizedString: If you don't mind... The mysterious dancer in front of you is no other than Mr. Bai Mo, president of the Bai Group and leader of the Urbino Business Alliance.

TextContext.SourceString: 真是令人印象深刻的舞蹈呢……
TextContext.LocalizedString: What an impressive dance...

TextContext.SourceString: 请问，白先生在哪里呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Excuse me, where can we find Mr. Bai?

TextContext.SourceString: 星绘，快醒醒！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Wake up, Celestia!

TextContext.SourceString: 不要逃避现实！
TextContext.LocalizedString: You can't escape from reality!

TextContext.SourceString: 实在是不好意思……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm terribly sorry...

TextContext.SourceString: 我真的没想到，星庇所的投资人会是这样……有个性的一位先生。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I didn't expect the person who invested in Astral Sanctuary... to be such a unique gentleman.

TextContext.SourceString: 哈哈哈，我就把这当作是夸奖吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ha-ha. I'll take that as a compliment.

TextContext.SourceString: 白墨先生，今天我们冒昧拜访是为了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Mr. Bai, we have come today because...

TextContext.SourceString: 先别说那些无聊的事……星绘小姐，你介意跳上一曲吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hold that thought... Miss Celestia, would you care to dance?

TextContext.SourceString: 咦，什么意思？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Huh? I don't follow.

TextContext.SourceString: 就字面意思啊，看见那个跳舞机了吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: That wasn't a metaphor. See the arcade machine over there?

TextContext.SourceString: 那玩意也是我投的，就当是帮我测试测试呗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: I've invested in that as well. Why don't you help me test it?

TextContext.SourceString: 随便选首曲子……等你跳完我们再谈。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Pick any song you like... We'll talk when you're done.
What...

TextContext.SourceString: （星绘似乎有些为难的样子，这时候应该……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Celestia seems uncomfortable... Should I...)

TextContext.SourceString: （自告奋勇）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Volunteer)

TextContext.SourceString: （毛遂自荐）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Offer to do it in her stead)

TextContext.SourceString: 哦？引航者吗？这我倒是没想到……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh? Navigator? That's unexpected...

TextContext.SourceString: 我听说你是个只会偶尔动动嘴皮子的惜字如金无口人。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I heard you were someone who rarely takes action.

TextContext.SourceString: 听起来比神秘街舞男要好一点。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Sounds a lot better than “mysterious dancer”.

TextContext.SourceString: 真敢说啊。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Aren't you a bold one?

TextContext.SourceString: 有意思，那就让我看看你的本事！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Very well. Show me what you've got!

TextContext.SourceString: （站上跳舞机）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I step onto the arcade machine.)

TextContext.SourceString: （跳舞机的界面上显示出一大串音乐列表。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The screen displays a long list of tracks.)

TextContext.SourceString: （这里就凭感觉选择……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I will pick...)

TextContext.SourceString: 舒缓的乐曲
TextContext.LocalizedString: A gentle song

TextContext.SourceString: 别太天真了，舒缓的音乐可不一定意味着简单。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Don't be naive. A gentle song doesn't necessarily mean it's easy.

TextContext.SourceString: 轻快的乐曲
TextContext.LocalizedString: An upbeat song

TextContext.SourceString: 不错的曲子，让人心情愉快，但这曲子很长，可能会是一场拉力战。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Good choice. This one is uplifting but quite long. This may take a while.

TextContext.SourceString: 激昂的乐曲
TextContext.LocalizedString: An intense song

TextContext.SourceString: 节奏、动感、激烈的对抗，我很喜欢……你确定这曲子适合你？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Rhythmic, dynamic, confrontational. I like it... Are you sure you can handle it?

TextContext.SourceString: （音乐响起，界面上开始落下音符。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As the music starts, notes begin to drop from the top of the screen.)

TextContext.SourceString: （似乎只要在正确的时机踩上对应的踏板就能得分，并没有限制使用怎样的舞步。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (It seems that stepping on the corresponding pads at the right time scores points without any restrictions on what dance moves to use.)

TextContext.SourceString: （用小幅度的舞步，避免体力消耗）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Use small dance steps to conserve stamina)

TextContext.SourceString: 舞蹈本应是自由的，别把它当成负担啊。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Dancing should be a free thing. Don't treat it as a burden.

TextContext.SourceString: （跟随节奏，随心使出适合的舞步）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Follow the rhythm and dance freely)

TextContext.SourceString: 随心而动是不错，不过这可需要天赋和手段。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Dancing freely is good, but it requires talent and skills.

TextContext.SourceString: （想办法跳出尽可能帅气的舞步）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Try to dance impressively)

TextContext.SourceString: 很有表现欲啊，但以新手来说是不是操之过急了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Quite the performer, aren't you? But isn't that a bit too ambitious for a beginner?

TextContext.SourceString: （随着音乐渐入高潮，游戏的难度也陡然提升。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As the track song hits its climax, the difficulty of the game significantly increases.)

TextContext.SourceString: （面对不断下落的音符……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As the notes keep falling...)

TextContext.SourceString: （底力全开，以全连击为目标）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Go all out, aiming for full combos)

TextContext.SourceString: （说是这么说，但面对瀑布一般下落的音符，身体的反应逐渐无法跟上节奏。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As much as I am trying my best, my body cannot keep up with the notes falling like a waterfall.)

TextContext.SourceString: （适当放弃高难部分，保证接住其它音符）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Give up on the most difficult notes and try to hit the rest)

TextContext.SourceString: （即使放过了高难部分，想接住剩余的音符也让人捉襟见肘，放过的音符不断触底造成了大量减分。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Even though I have given up on the most difficult notes, it is still challenging trying to hit the remaining notes. The missed notes significantly reduce my total score.)

TextContext.SourceString: （音乐结束，跳舞机上弹出了一个惨烈的分数——大概不到白墨的十分之一吧。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As the song comes to an end, a terrible score pops up on the screen - probably less than one-tenth of Bai Mo's.)

TextContext.SourceString: （虽说是游戏，但却比想象得累的多，跳完一曲感觉全身都快散架了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Although it is just a game, it was much more tiring than I expected. Afterward, I feel like my body is falling apart.)

TextContext.SourceString: 看起来，这个游戏对你来说好像太难了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Looks like the game's too difficult for you.

TextContext.SourceString: 别太勉强，想超过我的记录可没那么容易。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Don't beat yourself up. My record is hard to beat.

TextContext.SourceString: 不，我没这么打算啊？
TextContext.LocalizedString: That wasn't my intention.

TextContext.SourceString: 下一次一定可以！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'll get you next time!

TextContext.SourceString: 玩笑就开到这里吧，白墨。客人已经等了很久了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: That's enough, Bai Mo. Our guests have been waiting for a while now.

TextContext.SourceString: 白先生，我们来是为了星庇所的事。
TextContext.LocalizedString: We're here about Astral Sanctuary, Mr. Bai.

TextContext.SourceString: 不需要话语，从引航者的舞步里我已经知晓了一切。
TextContext.LocalizedString: There is no need for words. I've learned everything from the navigator's dancing.

TextContext.SourceString: 乐曲的选择，正是星庇所所追求的理想……
TextContext.LocalizedString: The choice of music perfectly reflects Astral Sanctuary's ideals...

TextContext.SourceString: 舞步的变换，是星庇所面对现实的无力……
TextContext.LocalizedString: The variation in dance moves symbolizes Astral Sanctuary's helplessness in facing the unfortunate reality...

TextContext.SourceString: 而最后的高潮……不好意思，那副惨状可称不上高潮，只是个无聊的结局罢了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: As for the climax... Forgive my bluntness, but your pitiful dance moves were no climax but a dull ending.

TextContext.SourceString: 而且，现在的星庇所毫无疑问会一股脑向着同样的结局冲刺。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Moreover, Astral Sanctuary, in its current state, faces the same ending no matter how hard you try.

TextContext.SourceString: 那您一定有办法帮助星庇所，对吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You must know how to help us, right?

TextContext.SourceString: 我就直说了——
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'll get straight to the point.

TextContext.SourceString: 白氏集团投资星庇所，可不是为了做慈善。
TextContext.LocalizedString: We didn't invest in Astral Sanctuary because we were philanthropic.

TextContext.SourceString: 白墨，你应该知道，星庇所对崩溃症的疗法探索处于行业的前沿。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You should know, Bai Mo, that Astral Sanctuary's treatment of collapse syndrome is the best in the industry.

TextContext.SourceString: 创新与开拓，是乌尔比诺的生命之源，身为盟主的你应该比我更清楚吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Innovation and pioneering are Urbino's lifeblood. As its leader, you should be well aware of that!

TextContext.SourceString: 一时的短视可能就会葬送一条崭新的、长远的价值链条！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Your short-sightedness could destroy a brand-new, long-term value chain!

TextContext.SourceString: 我不否定，这也是白氏投资星庇所的理由。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I don't deny it. This is why we invested in Astral Sanctuary in the first place.

TextContext.SourceString: 不过，如果星庇所坚持现在的经营方针，白氏的投资与回报将不成比例。除非……
TextContext.LocalizedString: However, if Astral Sanctuary carries on with its current management policy, our return will be disproportionate to our investment. Unless...

TextContext.SourceString: 等等，你该不会想……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Wait. You're not thinking of...

TextContext.SourceString: 把专利权卖给白氏，这就是白氏集团对星庇所进行追加融资的条件。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Sell the patent to us. This is the condition for the Bai Group to provide additional financing to Astral Sanctuary.

TextContext.SourceString: 为了扩大经营，收治更多病患，星绘小姐应该不介意让出一点蝇头小利吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: In the interest of expanding and treating more patients, I'm sure you wouldn't mind giving up a tiny bit of profit, Miss Celestia, would you?

TextContext.SourceString: 为了……病患……
TextContext.LocalizedString: For the patients...

TextContext.SourceString: 等等，星绘。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Wait, Celestia.

TextContext.SourceString: 如果失去了对专利权的控制，星庇所就会完全变成白氏的傀儡！
TextContext.LocalizedString: If you give up the patent, Astral Sanctuary will become their puppet!

TextContext.SourceString: 我说啊，奥黛丽，联盟的规矩你忘了吗？这是白氏和星庇所之间的事。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Have you forgotten the rules of the alliance, Audrey? This matter is strictly between the Bai Group and Astral Sanctuary.

TextContext.SourceString: 再说了，我也只是根据现状给出了最合理的提议。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Besides, I've provided nothing but the most reasonable solution given the current situation.

TextContext.SourceString: 是否接受，全看星绘小姐自己。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's up to Miss Celestia whether to accept it or not.

TextContext.SourceString: 乌尔比诺没有强买强卖，也没有坑蒙拐骗，一切交易都出于自由意志的选择。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Urbino does not force sales, nor do we engage in deception. All transactions are made on the basis of free will.

TextContext.SourceString: 这一点，我这个盟主可以拍胸脯保证。
TextContext.LocalizedString: As its leader, you have my word.

TextContext.SourceString: 怎么说，给个话儿呗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: So? What do you say?

TextContext.SourceString: 我……我想好了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I... I've made up my mind.

TextContext.SourceString: 奥黛丽小姐说得对，我没法把崩溃症患者治愈的希望交付给白墨先生你这样的人。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Lady Audrey is right. I cannot entrust the hope of curing collapse syndrome patients to someone like you, Mr. Bai.

TextContext.SourceString: 对不起，白墨先生，我必须郑重拒绝你的提议。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm sorry, Mr. Bai, but I cannot accept your proposal.

TextContext.SourceString: 而且……星庇所不会再向白氏集团要求融资，我们会靠自己解决问题。无论用什么方法！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Moreover... Astral Sanctuary will not seek additional financing from the Bai Group. We will find a way to resolve our current situation!

TextContext.SourceString: 唉，看来我被讨厌了啊？行吧……我也不会劝你。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You really don't like me, do you? Very well... Be that as it may.

TextContext.SourceString: 但只要走出这扇门，白氏集团的大门就会永远对你关上。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Remember: the moment you walk out of this room, you can kiss our money goodbye.

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，不劳费心，我们告辞了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Thanks for your kind words. Goodbye, Mr. Bai.

TextContext.SourceString: （星绘一旦下定决心，就谁也劝不动了，她头也不回地向门外走去。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Once Celestia makes up her mind, no one may persuade her otherwise. She starts walking toward the exit without any hesitation.)

TextContext.SourceString: （看来，与白墨的谈判只能以失败告终了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (It seems that our negotiation with Bai Mo has failed.)

TextContext.SourceString: （从今往后的星庇所，会怎么样呢？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (What is going to happen to Astral Sanctuary?)

TextContext.SourceString: 等等。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Wait a moment!

TextContext.SourceString: 等等。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Wait a moment!

TextContext.SourceString: （就在星绘即将迈出门口的时候，奥黛丽赶在那之前拦住了她。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Just as Celestia is about to step out of the door, Audrey stops her.)

TextContext.SourceString: 奥黛丽……小姐？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Lady Audrey?

TextContext.SourceString: 星绘，这里就交给我吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Leave it to me, Astierred.

TextContext.SourceString: （承受着星绘不解的眼神，奥黛丽径直走向了白墨。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Celestia looks at Audrey puzzledly as the latter walks straight to Bai Mo.)

TextContext.SourceString: 白墨，你已经打算放弃星庇所了吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Are you giving up on Astral Sanctuary, Bai Mo?

TextContext.SourceString: 没错，无法产生利益的投资，已经只剩一笔烂账了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I am. An investment that does not generate profit is a bad debt.

TextContext.SourceString: 那么这笔账，就由格罗夫来接手。
TextContext.LocalizedString: In that case, Grove Enterprises will take over from you.

TextContext.SourceString: 格罗夫集团将全额收购白氏持有的星庇所的所有股份，这样一来就不会产生交叉，应该不算违反联盟的规矩吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: We will acquire all shares of Astral Sanctuary held by the Bai Group, thus avoiding any conflicts of interest. Surely, this doesn't violate any alliance rules, right?

TextContext.SourceString: 诶？怎么突然之间……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Uh? What's going on?..

TextContext.SourceString: 哈？你认真的？这可真是今天最劲爆的事。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Are you serious? This is going to make today's headlines.

TextContext.SourceString: 我在星庇所的身上看到了你看不到的价值。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I see in Astral Sanctuary something you don't.

TextContext.SourceString: 真的假的？嘿，有意思……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Really? Interesting...

TextContext.SourceString: （白墨只是短暂地思考了一会，很快就做出了决定。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Bai Mo ponders briefly before making a decision.)

TextContext.SourceString: 既然这样……好吧，我卖了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: In that case... Alright, I'll sell.

TextContext.SourceString: 这么简单就决定了吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Just like that?

TextContext.SourceString: 你决定的也太快了吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: That was quick.

TextContext.SourceString: 只要是合理的交易，没有理由不答应。这样一来，星庇所也能产生对我有利的价值。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I have no reason to reject a fair deal. This will also enable Astral Sanctuary to generate value for me.

TextContext.SourceString: 但是奥黛丽……别忘了你可是乌尔比诺的常任理事。
TextContext.LocalizedString: But, Audrey... don't you forget that you're a permanent director of Urbino.

TextContext.SourceString: 能驱动乌尔比诺前进的，是利益和价值。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Profit and value are the drive behind Urbino.

TextContext.SourceString: 所以我希望，你真的知道自己在做什么。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I hope for your sake that you know what you're doing.

TextContext.SourceString: 注意你的发言，白大盟主。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Watch your language, Mr. Leader.

TextContext.SourceString: 虽然还只是口头协议……但现在，星庇所已经是我的盟友了，不是你用来交易的筹码。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Although this is only a verbal agreement... Astral Sanctuary is now an ally of mine. It's not a chip for you to trade with.

TextContext.SourceString: 好吧好吧，如果这家小诊所真的对你这么重要……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Very well. If this small clinic is really that important to you...

TextContext.SourceString: 那就请把这次交易当成我的诚意。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Please consider this deal as my goodwill.

TextContext.SourceString: 然后，好好考虑一下我在理事会上的提案。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Think about my proposal at the council.

TextContext.SourceString: 好啦，我还得去参加艾顿城的喷漆挑战赛呢，不送了~
TextContext.LocalizedString: Alright. I still have the spray challenge in Arton City to attend. Good day.

TextContext.SourceString: 奥黛丽小姐……真不好意思，没想到会给你添这么大的麻烦。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Lady Audrey... Please accept my apologies. I didn't mean to cause you any trouble.

TextContext.SourceString: 呼……没什么大不了的，我早就想给那家伙一点颜色看看了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Phew... It's fine. I've been wanting to teach that guy a lesson for a while now.

TextContext.SourceString: 今天也算出了一口恶气，真是舒爽多了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: This was a chance for me to vent my frustration. I feel much better already.

TextContext.SourceString: 刚才的奥黛丽太帅了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: You were awesome, Audrey.

TextContext.SourceString: 这才像是格罗夫的独角兽啊。
TextContext.LocalizedString: That's the Unicorn Grove I know.

TextContext.SourceString: 是、是这样吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: I-Is that so?

TextContext.SourceString: 不过，说起来这也是向引航者你学来的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're actually the one who taught me to act this way, Navigator.

TextContext.SourceString: 还记得你为了星庇所向我进行交涉的时候吗？我不过是做了和那时候一样的事。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Remember when you came to me on behalf of Astral Sanctuary? I only did what you did back then.

TextContext.SourceString: 我也有这么帅吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Was I as awesome as you were just now?

TextContext.SourceString: 是啊，那时候的前辈也非常帅气呢！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Indeed. You were amazing!

TextContext.SourceString: 这么说有点怪不好意思……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Awww. I'm embarrassed...

TextContext.SourceString: 我是发自真心地这么认为。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I mean it, truly.

TextContext.SourceString: 从今往后，星庇所就是格罗夫集团真正意义上的盟友了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: From now on, Astral Sanctuary is an ally of Grove Enterprises.

TextContext.SourceString: 星庇所的资金问题，我会想办法解决的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'll find a way to resolve your financial issues.

TextContext.SourceString: 奥黛丽小姐已经是星庇所的大股东了，以后可得注意和奥黛丽小姐说话的语气了呢~
TextContext.LocalizedString: Lady Audrey is now a majority stockholder of Astral Sanctuary. You'll have to mind your manners with her, Navigator.

TextContext.SourceString: 不，星绘……我答应你，我们的关系不会改变，你和引航者永远都会是我的朋友。
TextContext.LocalizedString: No, Celestia... I promise you that this will not affect our relationship. You and the Navigator will always be my friends.

TextContext.SourceString: 但是相对的，能请你们也答应我一个要求吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: In return, could you promise me something?

TextContext.SourceString: 当然没问题！请说吧，奥黛丽小姐。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Of course! What is it, Lady Audrey?

TextContext.SourceString: 那就是——坚持你们的初心，无论发生什么，都绝不放弃任何一个患者。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Promise me that you will stick to what you started out to do, never giving up on any patient, no matter what happens.

TextContext.SourceString: 我答应你。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I promise you.

TextContext.SourceString: 这是理所当然的啊！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Of course!

TextContext.SourceString: 前辈说的对！而且，这也正是因为有了奥黛丽小姐的支持才能做到！
TextContext.LocalizedString: The Navigator is right! Your support has made it possible!

TextContext.SourceString: 呵呵，听到你们这么说我就放心了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm glad to hear that.

TextContext.SourceString: 我敢肯定，这会是一笔有价值的投资。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm sure this will be a valuable investment.

TextContext.SourceString: 去吧，星庇所的患者们还在等着你们吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Go on, then. There must be patients waiting for you back at Astral Sanctuary.

TextContext.SourceString: （奥黛丽停住了脚步，用眼神向我们告别。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Audrey stops walking and sees us off.)

TextContext.SourceString: （我们登上奥黛丽安排的专车，驶向了星庇所的方向。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (We get in the limousine arranged by Audrey, heading toward Astral Sanctuary.)

TextContext.SourceString: （奥黛丽在后视镜中微笑着向着我们缓缓挥手，直到被完全淹没在人群之中。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I see Audrey smiling and slowly waving at us in the rearview mirror until she disappears into the crowd.)

TextContext.SourceString: （在确认到车子即将离开视线的短短一瞬，我似乎看到了——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Just as the car is about to leave her sight, I think I see...)

TextContext.SourceString: （精心装扮的笑容从她的脸上消失。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (...The carefully maintained smile fading from her face.)

TextContext.SourceString: （是夜，纽特朗的天空落起了小雨。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (At night, light rain falls over Neutroville.)

TextContext.SourceString: （时钟滴答，雨声淅沥。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The clock ticks as rain falls.)

TextContext.SourceString: （整座城市，仿佛只剩下她无法入睡。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As if she is the only one in the entire sleep unable to sleep.)

TextContext.SourceString: 不行，这样下去的话……
TextContext.LocalizedString: This cannot go on...

TextContext.SourceString: （昏暗的书房里，只有显示器上的一串串赤字格外刺眼。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (In the dim study, a string of red characters is glaringly bright.)

TextContext.SourceString: （点开不合时宜地响起的邮件提示，不出意外——又是公关部门发出的舆情报表。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (She clicks the inopportunely arrived email. Unsurprisingly, it is another report from Public Relations.)

TextContext.SourceString: （奥黛丽的脸上挂满了绝不轻易在人前显露的愁容。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Audrey looks troubled, an expression she would never show in front of others.)

TextContext.SourceString: 格罗夫银行事件的影响，远比预想得更大……
TextContext.LocalizedString: The impact of the Grove Bank Incident is far greater than she anticipated...

TextContext.SourceString: 搜查局至今也无法查出神秘敌人的真身，剪刀手也坚持撇清了关系……
TextContext.LocalizedString: The Bureau of Investigation has not been able to identify the mysterious enemy, while The Scissors claim to have nothing to do with it...

TextContext.SourceString: 欧泊不愿在这件事上发声，民意将暴动归咎为难民的自发行为，而格罗夫则要为赈灾不力而负责。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Painting Utopia Security refuses to comment on the matter. Public opinion blames the riot on the refugees. Grove Enterprises is being held responsible for failing to respond to the disaster.

TextContext.SourceString: 公信力的下降，也导致了储蓄的流失……简直是雪上加霜。
TextContext.LocalizedString: To add insult to injury, the decline in our credibility has also led to a loss of our savings.

TextContext.SourceString: 曾经的商业伙伴不约而同地落井下石，如此步调一致，一定有理事会成员的挑唆……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Our former business partners are unanimously kicking us while we're down. Such synergy could only have resulted from the instigation of a board member.

TextContext.SourceString: 西塔罗生物集团，切特尼克战术公司，还有温克勒商会……觊觎格罗夫的份额已久。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Citaro Biotech, Cherrus Tactical, and Winkler Consortium... All of them have long coveted our share.

TextContext.SourceString: 上次的会议虽然被白墨给打断了，但他们一定不会善罢甘休。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Bai Mo interrupted our last meeting. But they won't let it go. I'm sure of it.

TextContext.SourceString: 恐怕想要趁此机会把碍眼的独角兽彻底咬死吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm afraid that they want to seize the opportunity and get rid of the troublesome Unicorn once and for all.

TextContext.SourceString: 至于白氏集团……难以判断。
TextContext.LocalizedString: As for the Bai Group... it's hard to say.

TextContext.SourceString: 他不会真的觉得我会同意那种乱来的提案吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: He wouldn't really believe I'd agree to such a reckless proposal, would he?

TextContext.SourceString: 还是说，这只是那家伙的烟雾弹……不行，想不通。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Perhaps it was part of his smokescreen... I can't figure it out.

TextContext.SourceString: （将理不清的思绪暂且放在一边，奥黛丽试着活动了一下身子。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Setting aside this tangled issue of hers, Audrey tries to relax her body and mind.)

TextContext.SourceString: 哈……完全是死局。能走的路，一条都没有。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hmm... It's a complete deadlock. There's no way out.

TextContext.SourceString: “奥黛丽”……如果是你的话，到底会怎么办呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Audrey... What would you do?

TextContext.SourceString: （想到这里，奥黛丽的心中生出了一股难以言喻的矛盾心情。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Thinking of this, Audrey feels an indescribable sense of contradiction.)

TextContext.SourceString: 买下一个入不敷出的小诊所，这样毫无商业价值的行为，“你”一定不会同意吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Buying a failing clinic. You would never agree to something that makes as little financial sense as this, would you?

TextContext.SourceString: 但是我……为什么会不由自主地想要这么做？
TextContext.LocalizedString: But why... Why do I instinctively want to do this?

TextContext.SourceString: （思索片刻，奥黛丽熄灭了屏幕，从书桌下的小型保险柜中取出了一本纸质的日记本。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (After a moment of thought, Audrey turns off her computer, taking out a diary from a small safe under her desk.)

TextContext.SourceString: （这是奥黛丽与“过去的自己”唯一的联系。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (This is the only connection Audrey has with her past self.)

TextContext.SourceString: （她依赖着这本日记，却也害怕着这本日记。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (She relies on the diary as much as she is afraid of it.)

TextContext.SourceString: （她用日记中的碎片拼凑自我，却也害怕被日记中的碎片吞噬。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Piecing herself together using fragments from the diary, she fears being consumed by the very fragments.)

TextContext.SourceString: （正因如此，这本日记，她从来没有读到过最后。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As a result, she has never finished reading it.)

TextContext.SourceString: “钢铁的独角兽”啊……真亏你能被起一个这么夸张的绰号呢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The Steel Unicorn... It's quite something to have such an exaggerated nickname.

TextContext.SourceString: 到底用了什么样的手段……有什么样的诀窍……
TextContext.LocalizedString: What method did you use... What tricks did you have...

TextContext.SourceString: 在我没读完的这本日记之中，究竟还有多少我不知道的“你”？
TextContext.LocalizedString: How many different sides of you lie in the diary I have yet to finish reading?

TextContext.SourceString: 还有多少我应该知道的事——
TextContext.LocalizedString: How much more is there that I should know...

TextContext.SourceString: “这个编号方式我从来没见过……”
TextContext.LocalizedString: “I've never seen this numeral system...”

TextContext.SourceString: （不会吧……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (No way...)

TextContext.SourceString: （一种荒诞无比又似乎理所当然的可能性让奥黛丽惊出了一身冷汗。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (An absurd yet reasonable possibility sends chills down Audrey's spine.)

TextContext.SourceString: （急促的邮件提示音打断了奥黛丽的思绪。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The sudden email notification sound interrupts Audrey's thoughts.)

TextContext.SourceString: 邮件？又是公司的报表吗……都这个时间了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: A new email? Another company report... What time is it?

TextContext.SourceString: 不，这是私人地址？知道这个地址的人明明没有几个……
TextContext.LocalizedString: No, this is a private address. There are few who know it...

TextContext.SourceString: 发信人没有署名，地址是乱码？
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's sent by an anonymous sender with an encoded address.

TextContext.SourceString: 该不会是恶作剧吧……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Could it be a prank?..

TextContext.SourceString: （按捺着狂奔的心跳，奥黛丽打开了这封邮件。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Her heart racing, Audrey opens the email.)

TextContext.SourceString: （窗外，响起一声惊雷。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A clap of thunder suddenly echoes outside.)

TextContext.SourceString: 这是——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Is this...

TextContext.SourceString: （随后，骤雨将这个夜晚埋葬。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Then, the downpour buries the night.)

TextContext.SourceString: （星庇所内——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Inside Astral Sanctuary.)

TextContext.SourceString: （随着纽特朗连环爆炸案的平息，星庇所不再需要接收因此而产生的伤患。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As the aftermath of the Neutroville explosions settles, there are no more new patients for Astral Sanctuary to admit.)

TextContext.SourceString: （星庇所收治的患者也一名接一名康复出院。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (One by one, the patients are discharged after making full recoveries.)

TextContext.SourceString: 再见啦，小娜娜~回到家后可要好好听妈妈的话哦？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Bye, Nana. Listen to your mom when you get home, okay?

TextContext.SourceString: 星绘姐姐，娜娜下次再生病的时候，可以再来找你玩吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Astierred, if I get sick again, can I come back and play with you?

TextContext.SourceString: 呵呵，小傻瓜，就算不用生病也可以来找姐姐玩的啊。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Don't be silly, Nana. You're free to hang out with me even if you're not sick.

TextContext.SourceString: （微笑着送别了出院的患者，星绘一直凝固的肩头终于松懈了下来。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Smiling as she bids farewell to the discharged patients, Astierred finally seems relaxed for the first time in a long time.)

TextContext.SourceString: 这下，星庇所的运营终于能够逐渐回到正轨，专注于崩溃症的预防和治疗。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Now, we can finally get back on track and focus on the prevention and treatment of collapse syndrome.

TextContext.SourceString: 都是多亏了奥黛丽小姐的及时注资，才让星庇所平安渡过了这场危机。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The crisis has been averted thanks to Lady Audrey's timely investment.

TextContext.SourceString: 得好好谢谢她才行。
TextContext.LocalizedString: We must properly thank her.

TextContext.SourceString: 是啊……可是，我已经好久都没有见到奥黛丽小姐了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yes... But it's been a while since I last saw her.

TextContext.SourceString: 明明答应了会来星庇所作客……我还特意准备了一批新的试做版星芒咖啡来招待她。
TextContext.LocalizedString: She said she'd visit... I even made a new trial batch of Starlight Coffee for her.

TextContext.SourceString: （总不会是因为这个原因吧……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (This is not the reason she has not visited, is it...)

TextContext.SourceString: 身为知名企业家应该很忙吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: As a famous entrepreneur, she must be pretty busy.

TextContext.SourceString: 还是别去打扰她了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: We should leave her alone.

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，前辈，你说的对。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're right, Navigator.

TextContext.SourceString: （和星绘一起并肩站在星庇所的门口，一时无话，只有时间在静静地流逝。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Standing with Astierred by the entrance of Astral Sanctuary, we both fall silent as time passes.)

TextContext.SourceString: ……上一次像这样和前辈两个人悠闲地独处，好像已经是很久之前的事了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...It seems like forever ago when we last shared some peace and quiet together.

TextContext.SourceString: 这段时间发生了很多事。
TextContext.LocalizedString: A lot has been going on.

TextContext.SourceString: 好像还是在我刚刚加入星庇所的时候。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Back when I just joined Astral Sanctuary, if I recall correctly.

TextContext.SourceString: 是啊……不知不觉间，“前辈”已经成为星庇所不可缺少的一部分了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Indeed... You have become an indispensable part of Astral Sanctuary before I could realize it.

TextContext.SourceString: 但是，仔细想想……我好像还对前辈的事并不怎么了解。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Come to think of it... There is a lot about you that I have yet to know.

TextContext.SourceString: 什么意思？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What do you mean?

TextContext.SourceString: 在我收到的简历上说，前辈曾经是欧泊的崩溃症专家……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Your résumé mentioned that you were an expert on collapse syndrome back at P.U.S...

TextContext.SourceString: 咦，是吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Is that so?

TextContext.SourceString: （不知为何脱口而出的疑问……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I blurt out the question without realizing it...)

TextContext.SourceString: 但是，同为研究者，我却从来没有听说过前辈的名号……
TextContext.LocalizedString: However, as a fellow researcher, I'd never heard of you...

TextContext.SourceString: （明明是自己的事，却像是第一次听说……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Even though she is talking about my own background, it feels like I am hearing about it for the very first time...)

TextContext.SourceString: 前辈在欧泊进行的是什么样的研究呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What kind of research did you do back at P.U.S?

TextContext.SourceString: （……在来到星庇所之前……我在做什么？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (...What was I doing before coming to Astral Sanctuary?)

TextContext.SourceString: 啊！如果有保密条款的话就不用勉强了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh! You don't have to tell me anything if you are bound by an NDA!

TextContext.SourceString: （越去思考……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The more I think about it...)

TextContext.SourceString: 我也知道，欧泊的水面之下远比我知道的更加深邃……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I know there is more to P.U.S than meets the eye...

TextContext.SourceString: （就越是不解……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The more puzzled I become.)

TextContext.SourceString: 保留一点小秘密，也算是前辈的魅力之处嘛~
TextContext.LocalizedString: Your secrets actually make you more charming!

TextContext.SourceString: 所以，不用回答也可以……
TextContext.LocalizedString: So, you don't have to give me an answer...
Who's there?!

TextContext.SourceString: （脑海中的幻影倏然消散，就像从来没有存在过。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The illusion in my mind dissipates as if it never existed to begin with.)

TextContext.SourceString: （刚才为止还在困扰着我的某种思绪，也像断线一般消失无踪，再也想不起来。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The thought that has been troubling me vanishes suddenly, never to come back.)

TextContext.SourceString: （眼前只有一如既往陪在我身边的、熟悉的少女的身影，她的身边就是我该站立的地方。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I see in front of me the familiar face of the girl who has stood by me all this time, exactly where I belong.)

TextContext.SourceString: （我是星庇所的引航者，这是理所当然的事实。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I am the Navigator of Astral Sanctuary, an undeniable fact.)

TextContext.SourceString: 前辈？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Navigator?

TextContext.SourceString: （重新找回现实感的途中，从手腕上感到了一股不熟悉的重量感。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As I snap back to reality, I feel an unfamiliar weight on my wrist.)

TextContext.SourceString: 这个手环，怎么了吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What's happening to your bracelet?

TextContext.SourceString: 它刚才是不是亮了一下？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Did it light up?

TextContext.SourceString: 唔？有吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Uh? Did it?

TextContext.SourceString: 前辈不是一直在尝试启动它，但从来没有反应吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Haven't you been trying to activate it to no avail?

TextContext.SourceString: 奇怪……我一直都戴着它吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: How peculiar... Have I been wearing it all this time?

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，没错……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yes, you have...

TextContext.SourceString: 自从那天之后，前辈就一直把这个手环贴身保管。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You've kept it close ever since that day.

TextContext.SourceString: 前辈……你说，那些盯上这个手环的敌人还会来吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Navigator... do you think the people after the bracelet will come back?

TextContext.SourceString: 他们会来的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: They will.

TextContext.SourceString: 或许，已经来了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Or perhaps they already have.

TextContext.SourceString: （旁若无人地悠然踏入星庇所的——是一名举止优雅的长发女性。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A long-haired elegant woman walks into Astral Sanctuary as if she owns the place.)

TextContext.SourceString: （就像一只蝴蝶，轻轻地舞落在房间里。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Like a butterfly making its gentle descent.)

TextContext.SourceString: （美丽、优雅，还有……一丝不易察觉的危险。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Beautiful, elegant... and a barely perceptible hint of danger.)

TextContext.SourceString: （紧接着方才的话题出现的女性，令星绘十分警戒。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The woman who has suddenly appeared puts Celestia on high alert.)

TextContext.SourceString: 请问……您是？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Excuse me... may I help you?

TextContext.SourceString: 今天应该已经没有患者的预约了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: We're done with patient appointments for the day.

TextContext.SourceString: 您的样子，似乎也不需要医生的帮助。如果没事的话——
TextContext.LocalizedString: You don't look like you need medical attention. If there's nothing else...

TextContext.SourceString: 不是患者，就不能找你玩了吗？星绘小姐。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Can I not hang out with you if I'm not a patient, Miss Celestia?

TextContext.SourceString: 你——你对娜娜做什么了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You... What did you do to Nana?

TextContext.SourceString: 没什么，不过是和恰巧出院的可爱小朋友进行了一些亲切的交流罢了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Nothing. I just had a friendly chat with the lovely, recently discharged kid.

TextContext.SourceString: 你该不会是那些人的一员……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Are you one of them...

TextContext.SourceString: 我看起来像吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Do I look like one?

TextContext.SourceString: 别再装神弄鬼了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Stop beating around the bush.

TextContext.SourceString: 亮出真身吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Show yourself.

TextContext.SourceString: 呵，那么，容我自我介绍——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Very well. Allow me to introduce myself...

TextContext.SourceString: 欧泊之眼，芙拉薇娅。幸会。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Flavia, the Eye of P.U.S. A pleasure to meet you.

TextContext.SourceString: “欧泊之眼”……！
TextContext.LocalizedString: “The Eye of P.U.S”...

TextContext.SourceString: 那是什么？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What's that?

TextContext.SourceString: 我没听过。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Never heard of it.

TextContext.SourceString: 我也只是听过传闻而已……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I've only heard rumors...

TextContext.SourceString: 在欧泊的内部，有一支拥有独立指挥权的特别情报部队——
TextContext.LocalizedString: There is an independent special intelligence unit within P.U.S...

TextContext.SourceString: “复眼”，这是它的正确名字。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The Compound Eye. That's the name.

TextContext.SourceString: 我们是为了吞噬腐肉而存在的虫子，是欧泊进行自我手术的尖刀。
TextContext.LocalizedString: We are insects that exist to devour rotten flesh. The scalpel for P.U.S' surgery.

TextContext.SourceString: 我和前辈，还有星庇所——都已经和欧泊无关了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Neither I, Navigator, nor Astral Sanctuary is still associated with P.U.S.

TextContext.SourceString: 我有说过，是为了欧泊的事情来找你们吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: I didn't say that's why I'm here, did I?

TextContext.SourceString: 那……到底是为什么？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Then... what are you doing here?

TextContext.SourceString: 我读过了搜查局关于格罗夫银行事件的报告书……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I read the Bureau of Investigation's report on the Grove Bank incident...

TextContext.SourceString: 但说实话，写得一塌糊涂，许多细节都被一笔带过。
TextContext.LocalizedString: If I'm being honest, it's poorly written, glossing over many details.

TextContext.SourceString: 真想好好“教导”一下，让现在的搜查官学会如何书写规范的文档……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Makes me want to teach the current investigators how to properly write documents...

TextContext.SourceString: 不过……在那之前，还得请星绘小姐回答我几个问题。
TextContext.LocalizedString: But... Before that, I need you to answer a few questions, Miss Celestia.

TextContext.SourceString: 我……明白了，所以，请不要为难一线的搜查官们！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Understood... Please leave the investigators alone!

TextContext.SourceString: （得到了星绘的许可，芙拉薇娅立刻拿出准备好的材料开始了问讯。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (With Celestia's permission, Flavia produces the prepared materials and begins the inquiry.)

TextContext.SourceString: （我记得……负责报告的人应该是心夏吧？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (If I recall correctly... Kokona was responsible for the report.)

TextContext.SourceString: （是巧合吗？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Is it a coincidence?)

TextContext.SourceString: （难不成是故意的……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Was it on purpose...)

TextContext.SourceString: （我仔细观察着芙拉薇娅的表情，但从她从容的表情中却找不出一丝破绽。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Carefully observing Flavia's expression, I fail to find any flaw in her composed demeanor.)

TextContext.SourceString: （……也许是我多心了？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (...Perhaps I am overthinking it.)

TextContext.SourceString: （访谈的进行比预想的更加平稳。芙拉薇娅似乎是一个比看起来更好相处的人。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The interview goes a lot more smoothly than expected. Flavia is easier to get along with than she appears to be.)

TextContext.SourceString: （碍于芙拉薇娅的敏感身份而产生的隔阂也逐渐缓和下来。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The hostility as a result of her identity is gradually eased.)

TextContext.SourceString: 辛苦了，星绘小姐。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Thank you, Miss Astierred.

TextContext.SourceString: 这样一来，许多事实都清楚了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: That clears everything.

TextContext.SourceString: 你们在格罗夫银行事件中曾经对抗过的黑幕……
TextContext.LocalizedString: The mastermind behind the Grove Bank Incident...

TextContext.SourceString: 残酷，冷血，高效，为达目的不惜一切。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Cruel, cold-blooded, efficient. Stopping at nothing to achieve their goals.

TextContext.SourceString: 这种作风，果然很相像呢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The style is indeed similar.

TextContext.SourceString: 和什么？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Similar to whom?

TextContext.SourceString: 复眼一直在追踪的危险组织——
TextContext.LocalizedString: The dangerous organization the Compound Eye has been tracking...

TextContext.SourceString: “新伯利恒”。
TextContext.LocalizedString: New Bethlehem.

TextContext.SourceString: ……这个名字，还是第一次听说。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...This is the first time I've heard this name.

TextContext.SourceString: 当然。即使在复眼之中，新伯利恒的存在也近乎于都市传说。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Of course. Even within the Compound Eye, New Bethlehem is an urban legend.

TextContext.SourceString: 这是一个成员和目的都不明确的危险集团，关于他们的可靠信息极为稀少。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's a dangerous organization. We don't know exactly how many of them there are or what they want. There is a scarce supply of reliable information about them.

TextContext.SourceString: 如果不是引航者从爆炸案中推测出了他们的真实目的，恐怕这一次也要无功而返。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Had the Navigator not deduced their true objective from the explosions, we should have returned empty-handed once again.

TextContext.SourceString: 失去你这样的人才，实在是欧泊的损失。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Someone as talented as you leaving was a true loss for PUS.

TextContext.SourceString: 过奖了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're flattering me.

TextContext.SourceString: 不……你对我而言就有这样的价值……
TextContext.LocalizedString: No... You are truly valuable to me...

TextContext.SourceString: 你可以多夸两句。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Keep talking.

TextContext.SourceString: 呵呵，有机会的话，我可以单独的……
TextContext.LocalizedString: If you like, we could meet in private...

TextContext.SourceString: 引、引航者……不好意思，星庇所现在不接受挖角！
TextContext.LocalizedString: N-Navigator... Excuse me. We do not accept poaching!

TextContext.SourceString: 呵呵，别担心，复眼不需要有两位棋手。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Heh. Don't you worry. The Compound Eye does not need two players.

TextContext.SourceString: 不过，如果引航者愿意的话……
TextContext.LocalizedString: However, if you're interested, Navigator...

TextContext.SourceString: 对对对、对了！芙拉薇娅小姐，说回之前的问题吧！
TextContext.LocalizedString: R-R-Right! Let's get back on track, Miss Flavia!

TextContext.SourceString: 你刚才说，新伯利恒的作风和之前很相像？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You were saying New Bethlehem's style was similar to something?

TextContext.SourceString: ……之前，他们做过什么吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...What have they done before?

TextContext.SourceString: （也许是我的错觉，在星绘问出这个问题的同时，芙拉薇娅身上的氛围忽然发生了变化。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Perhaps it is my imagination, but as Celestia asks the question, the atmosphere around Flavia suddenly changes.)

TextContext.SourceString: 呵呵，你们也许听过这个故事。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Heh. You may have heard of this story.

TextContext.SourceString: 有一家企业……在年轻的继承人手中，从家族的内斗中重生。
TextContext.LocalizedString: There was a company... Under the leadership of the young heir, it was reborn from familial strife.

TextContext.SourceString: 在短短三年之间重新建立了纽特朗最繁荣的商业帝国，成为乌尔比诺的常任理事之一。
TextContext.LocalizedString: In just three years, the heir built the most prosperous business empire of Neutroville, becoming one of the permanent directors of Urbino in the process.

TextContext.SourceString: 舆论攻击，恶意收购……他们使用所有最有效率的方式击溃了一个又一个竞争对手。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Through slander and hostile takeovers... they defeated one competitor after another using the most efficient methods.

TextContext.SourceString: 残酷，冷血，高效，为达目的不惜一切。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Cruel, cold-blooded, efficient. Stopping at nothing to achieve their goals.

TextContext.SourceString: 不觉得很耳熟吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Does it sound familiar?

TextContext.SourceString: 等等！等等……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Wait! Wait...

TextContext.SourceString: 芙拉薇娅小姐，你说的是——
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're talking about...

TextContext.SourceString: 格罗夫集团的崛起，背后有着新伯利恒的影子。
TextContext.LocalizedString: New Bethlehem is behind the rise of Grove Enterprises.

TextContext.SourceString: 这就是我所抵达的结论。
TextContext.LocalizedString: This is my conclusion.

TextContext.SourceString: 这不可能！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Impossible!

TextContext.SourceString: 我不相信！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I don't believe it!

TextContext.SourceString: 对，一定是哪里搞错了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: No. You must be mistaken!

TextContext.SourceString: 我们所认识的奥黛丽小姐，绝对不会做这样的事！
TextContext.LocalizedString: The Audrey we know would never do something like this!

TextContext.SourceString: 而且……格罗夫银行事件，最大的受害者不就是奥黛丽小姐吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Besides... Wasn't she the biggest victim of the Grove Bank Incident?

TextContext.SourceString: 如你所说。
TextContext.LocalizedString: As you said.

TextContext.SourceString: 自从某一个时间开始，奥黛丽和格罗夫集团的行为发生了变化。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Since a certain point in time, Audrey's and Grove Enterprises' actions have changed.

TextContext.SourceString: 崩溃症夺走了她的记忆，以及过往的人际关系。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Collapse syndrome took away her memories and past relationships.

TextContext.SourceString: 现在的她，也许的确和新伯利恒毫无瓜葛。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Perhaps she does have nothing to do with New Bethlehem now.

TextContext.SourceString: 但是……格罗夫银行事件却将两者重新联系在了一起。
TextContext.LocalizedString: However... the Grove Bank Incident has reconnected the two.

TextContext.SourceString: 这真的只是巧合吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Is this really just a coincidence?

TextContext.SourceString: 我……相信奥黛丽小姐。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I... I believe in Lady Audrey.

TextContext.SourceString: 呵呵，是吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Is that so?

TextContext.SourceString: 那么，这就是今天这场访谈的最后一个问题——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Here comes the last question of today's interview:

TextContext.SourceString: 奥黛丽·格罗夫，究竟是“黑”还是“白”……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Is Audrey Grove on the dark side or the light side...

TextContext.SourceString: 这个问题，可以请你们来回答吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Could you answer the question, please?

TextContext.SourceString: 嘟嘟嘟……您所拨打的用户暂时无法接通。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Beep beep... The number you have reached is not available.

TextContext.SourceString: 嘟嘟嘟……您所拨打的用户暂时无法接通。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Beep beep... The number you have reached is not available.

TextContext.SourceString: 嘟嘟嘟……嘟嘟嘟……嘟嘟嘟……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Beep beep... Beep beep... Beep beep...

TextContext.SourceString: 快接啊，奥黛丽小姐，为什么不接电话……！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Come on, Audrey. Pick up...

TextContext.SourceString: （与奥黛丽联系无果，我们立即联系了格罗夫集团。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Unable to contact Audrey, we immediately reach out to Grove Enterprises.)

TextContext.SourceString: （从管家口中得知，今天早上，奥黛丽以洽谈业务的名目出门之后，就失去了所有联系。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The butler informs us that they have lost all contact with Audrey since she left for a business meeting this morning.)

TextContext.SourceString: （为了抓住这条唯一的线索，我和星绘来到了最有可能“洽谈业务”的地点——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Following the only clue we have, Astierred and I arrive at the most likely location for her meeting.)

TextContext.SourceString: （乌尔比诺联盟总部，正门。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Main entrance, Urbino HQ.)

TextContext.SourceString: 大家！听我说！不要吵架！不要吵架！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Listen to me, folks! Do not fight! Do not fight!

TextContext.SourceString: 欧泊也和乌尔比诺穿一条裤衩吗！？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Is PUS in cahoots with Urbino?

TextContext.SourceString: 别废话！让白墨出来！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Shut up! Tell Bai Mo to come out!

TextContext.SourceString: 什么盟主，就是个缩头乌龟！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Coward of a leader!

TextContext.SourceString: 我听说了！之前的能源涨价就是他的主意！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I heard the energy price hike was his idea!

TextContext.SourceString: 不说别的，能不能别再把喷漆涂我家门口了！？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Stop spraying my door!

TextContext.SourceString: 还有整天扛着个音响到处扰民！
TextContext.LocalizedString: And turn off your stupid speaker!

TextContext.SourceString: 这么多人……
TextContext.LocalizedString: There's a crowd...

TextContext.SourceString: 发生什么事了吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What's going on?

TextContext.SourceString: 我好像看到米雪儿了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: I think I saw Michele.

TextContext.SourceString: 欧泊的人怎么也在这？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What's P.U.S doing here?

TextContext.SourceString: 呀吼，你们好啊~
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hello there!

TextContext.SourceString: 心、心夏！！
TextContext.LocalizedString: K-Kokona!

TextContext.SourceString: 你从哪冒出来的？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Where the heck did you come from?

TextContext.SourceString: 差点吓出心脏病……
TextContext.LocalizedString: You almost gave me a heart attack...

TextContext.SourceString: 嘿，不好意思啦~
TextContext.LocalizedString: Sorry!

TextContext.SourceString: 我在执行侦察任务呢，可不能发出脚步声。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm on a mission. I can't let people hear me.

TextContext.SourceString: 发生什么事了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What's going on?

TextContext.SourceString: 啊？你们没看新闻吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Haven't you watched the news?

TextContext.SourceString: 今天一大早，关于乌尔比诺盟主白墨的负面新闻就传得满天飞。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Since this morning, there have been non-stop negative news reports about Bai Mo, the leader of Urbino.

TextContext.SourceString: 而且……内容是非常可信的内部会议记录。
TextContext.LocalizedString: To make matters worse... the reports cite credible internal meeting records.

TextContext.SourceString: 发现盟主是个这么不务正业的家伙，大家都很生气呢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: People are livid to find out that the leader is such an errant guy.

TextContext.SourceString: 之前对于格罗夫集团的不满，也有许多转向了白氏集团。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The widespread dissatisfaction toward Grove Enterprises has now turned to the Bai Group.

TextContext.SourceString: 为了避免发生上次那样的事，搜查局主动提出了协助乌尔比诺维持治安的提案。
TextContext.LocalizedString: To avoid a repeat of what happened last time, the Bureau of Investigation offered to help Urbino maintain public order.

TextContext.SourceString: 真是辛苦你们了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Thank you for your hard work.

TextContext.SourceString: 替我们和米雪儿打个招呼。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Tell Michele we said hi.

TextContext.SourceString: 好说好说。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You got it.

TextContext.SourceString: 对了，你们俩不在星庇所来这里干什么啊？
TextContext.LocalizedString: By the way, what are you doing here? Don't you have work to do at Astral Sanctuary?

TextContext.SourceString: （星绘似乎有些犹豫，用眼神征求我的意见。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Seemingly hesitant, Astierred looks at me, seeking my opinion.)

TextContext.SourceString: （关于奥黛丽可能与事件有关的怀疑，现在还是不要声张为好。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (We should keep our suspicions about Audrey to ourselves for now.)

TextContext.SourceString: 嘿嘿，没事，也用不着告诉我。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Don't worry about it. You don't have to tell me anything.

TextContext.SourceString: 你们来是有正事要做吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're here on business, right?

TextContext.SourceString: 跟我来，带你们走小路，别被门口那些人缠上了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Follow me. I know a shortcut to avoid all the people at the main entrance.

TextContext.SourceString: （不愧是经验丰富的狙击手，心夏十分了解如何利用地形和躲避视线。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As an experienced sniper, Kokona excels at using terrain to avoid being seen.)

TextContext.SourceString: （在心夏的带领下，我们在谁也没察觉到情况下溜到了总部大楼的防火通道。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Following Kokona, we sneak into the building's fire escape unnoticed.)

TextContext.SourceString: （和心夏告别后，我们成功进入了乌尔比诺总部。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (After bidding farewell to Kokona, we successfully enter Urbino's headquarters.)

TextContext.SourceString: （时隔多日，再次来到乌尔比诺总部。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Back at Urbino HQ after a while.)

TextContext.SourceString: （今天的氛围和以往都不太一样。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The atmosphere feels different today.)

TextContext.SourceString: （没有来往的商务精英，取而代之的是全副武装的安保队员。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Instead of the usual businessmen, there are armed security personnel.)

TextContext.SourceString: 什么人！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Who the?!

TextContext.SourceString: （安保队员们没有预料到我们的出现，紧张地举起了武器。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Not expecting us, the guards tensely raise their weapons.)

TextContext.SourceString: （一个看起来像是队长的人走近了我们。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A man who seems to be the captain of the guards approaches us.)

TextContext.SourceString: 等等！我们是乌尔比诺的加盟企业代表！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hold on! We're representatives of a company affiliated with Urbino!

TextContext.SourceString: 没收到通知吗？今天有特情，总部暂停运营一天。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Haven't you heard? Due to special circumstances, HQ is closed for the day.

TextContext.SourceString: 既然来了，先报个备吧，哪家的？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Nonetheless, I have to record this. Which company do you work for?

TextContext.SourceString: 我们是来自白氏……不对，现在是格罗夫集团旗下的星庇所！
TextContext.LocalizedString: We're from the Bai... No. I mean Astral Sanctuary under Grove Enterprises!

TextContext.SourceString: 格罗夫……？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Grove...

TextContext.SourceString: 你等等……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Excuse me...

TextContext.SourceString: （安保队员打开了头戴通讯器，小声地进行报告。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The security guard turns on his headset and reports in a low voice.)

TextContext.SourceString: 对，是……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Copy. Affirmative...

TextContext.SourceString: ……他们是这么说的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...That's what they said.

TextContext.SourceString: ……明白。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...Roger that.

TextContext.SourceString: （虽然听不清谈话的内容，但安保队员的神情似乎变得紧张了起来。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Although the content of the conversation remains unclear to me, I notice that the captain seems to become more and more nervous.)

TextContext.SourceString: （心中有一点不好的预感……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I have a bad feeling...)

TextContext.SourceString: 你，你，过来。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You two, come here.

TextContext.SourceString: （听到指示的另外两名安保队员立即贴近了还没搞清楚状况的我们身边。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Upon hearing their captain's order, two other guards immediately approach us, they are still unclear about the situation.)

TextContext.SourceString: 不好意思两位，接到指示，所有格罗夫集团的成员都要接受乌尔比诺安监部门的内部调查。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Sorry. We have been instructed that all members of Grove Enterprises must be investigated by Urbino Security.

TextContext.SourceString: 请跟我们走一趟吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Please come with us.

TextContext.SourceString: 怎么回事？请解释一下！
TextContext.LocalizedString: What's wrong? Tell me what's going on!

TextContext.SourceString: 格罗夫集团有涉及一级泄密事件的高度嫌疑，我们只是执行决定，请理解。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Grove Enterprises is suspected of being involved in a top-level leak. We're just following orders.

TextContext.SourceString: （对方的主张并无不妥，实在找不出辩驳的理由。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The captain has given us an official explanation. I do not have a reason to argue with him.)

TextContext.SourceString: （这里还是先配合一下吧……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (It is better to cooperate for now...)

TextContext.SourceString: 等等……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Wait...

TextContext.SourceString: 盟主！？您怎么下来了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Leader? What are you doing down here?

TextContext.SourceString: 小心点！别让外面那些人看见您，他们要硬冲进来我们可拦不住！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Please be careful! If the crowd sees you, we won't be able to stop all of them!

TextContext.SourceString: 放了他们，这两个人的话没问题。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Release them. They're okay.

TextContext.SourceString: 他们是我约的客人。
TextContext.LocalizedString: They're my guests.
What...

TextContext.SourceString: 可是白叡先生交待……
TextContext.LocalizedString: But Mr. Bai Rui instructed that...

TextContext.SourceString: 怎么——我这个“盟主”说了不算？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Am I no longer the leader?

TextContext.SourceString: 不、不敢……放、放了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Of course you are... L-Let them go!

TextContext.SourceString: 走吧，跟我来。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Come on. Follow me.

TextContext.SourceString: 来，说说吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Now, talk.

TextContext.SourceString: “格罗夫”家的星庇所，大驾光临，有何指教？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're from Astral Sanctuary of Grove Enterprises, right? To what do I owe the pleasure?

TextContext.SourceString: 在那之前，能不能请您解释一下，刚才到底是怎么回事？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Before I answer your question, could you please tell me what is going on?

TextContext.SourceString: 怎么回事？我才想问呢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I was hoping you'd be able to tell me.

TextContext.SourceString: 就像你们看到的，睡了一觉醒来，我的丑闻就在整个纽特朗满天飞。
TextContext.LocalizedString: As you've seen, I woke up to find my scandal all over Neutroville.

TextContext.SourceString: 拜此所赐，公关部和安监联手给我下了禁足令。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Thanks to that, PR and Security have decided to ground me.

TextContext.SourceString: 现在我这个“盟主”哪也去不了，只能当个缩头乌龟。真没意思。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Despite being the leader of the alliance, I can only hide out here. Boring.

TextContext.SourceString: 看来盟主也不怎么自由。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I guess being the leader doesn't make you free.

TextContext.SourceString: 还真让你说对了……就是这么回事。
TextContext.LocalizedString: That's exactly what it is.

TextContext.SourceString: 至于你们……也真是不懂看气氛，自己撞到枪口上来。
TextContext.LocalizedString: As for you two... Your timing is terrible. You've walked straight into the line of fire.

TextContext.SourceString: 现在整个联盟里，“格罗夫”可是嫌疑最大的怀疑对象。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Grove Enterprises is the biggest suspect in the alliance as of now.

TextContext.SourceString: 要不是遇到我，你们可就麻烦大了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Had you not run into me, you'd be in serious trouble now.

TextContext.SourceString: 白墨先生也认为——泄露消息、传播丑闻的是奥黛丽小姐吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Mr. Bai, do you also believe that it was Lady Audrey who leaked the information and spread your scandal?

TextContext.SourceString: 我怎么认为并不重要，重要的是——
TextContext.LocalizedString: What I believe doesn't matter. The important thing is that...

TextContext.SourceString: 乌尔比诺下一届的盟主竞选开幕在即，而奥黛丽的格罗夫集团是白氏最大的竞争对手。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The next Urbino leadership election is about to start. Audrey's Grove Enterprises stands to be the Bai Group's biggest competitor.

TextContext.SourceString: 如今，乌尔比诺的各大家族都在观望这场闹剧的收尾。
TextContext.LocalizedString: All the major families of Urbino are watching how this drama ends.

TextContext.SourceString: 白氏和格罗夫，谁在竞争中落败，就会成为鬣狗们群起而攻的对象。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Between Grove and Bai, whoever loses is going to be attacked by the vultures.

TextContext.SourceString: 听明白的话就老老实实回去吧，这事不是你们能管的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I hope that answers your question. Go home now. There's nothing you can do to help.

TextContext.SourceString: 可是，如果什么都不做的话，不就会让真正的幕后黑手如愿以偿吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: If we stand back and do nothing, the mastermind behind all this is going to get exactly what they want.

TextContext.SourceString: “真正的幕后黑手”啊……
TextContext.LocalizedString: The mastermind?

TextContext.SourceString: 我已经够给你们留面子了，你们怎么还在说这种话。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Do you take me for a fool? Are you really that clueless?

TextContext.SourceString: 如果你们真的相信奥黛丽在这件事上是无辜的……
TextContext.LocalizedString: If you truly believe that Audrey is innocent.

TextContext.SourceString: 就把她带到我面前来，跟我当面对质。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Bring her to me. I'll ask her myself.

TextContext.SourceString: 怎么样，能做到吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Can you do that?

TextContext.SourceString: 我们联系了格罗夫集团，可是……
TextContext.LocalizedString: We've reached out to Grove Enterprises, but...

TextContext.SourceString: 奥黛丽小姐从今天早上开始就失去联系了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: No one has seen or heard from Lady Audrey since this morning.

TextContext.SourceString: 我们本以为她来了联盟总部……
TextContext.LocalizedString: We thought she'd come to HQ...

TextContext.SourceString: 如果她不在这里，那也许是遇到了什么紧急状况！
TextContext.LocalizedString: If she's not here, she might be in trouble!

TextContext.SourceString: 白氏集团能不能暂且放下对格罗夫集团的成见，和我们一起找到奥黛丽小姐……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Could you please set aside your prejudice against Grove Enterprises for a moment, Mr. Bai, and help us find Lady Audrey...

TextContext.SourceString: 这样可达不成交易啊，星绘。
TextContext.LocalizedString: This is not how you make a deal, Astierred.

TextContext.SourceString: 经过了上次的谈判，你们还是没学会乌尔比诺的规则。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It seems that you have yet to learn the rules of Urbino from our previous negotiation.

TextContext.SourceString: 我明白了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Understood...

TextContext.SourceString: 那我就用星庇所的专利权作为担保——
TextContext.LocalizedString: In that case, I'm putting Astral Sanctuary's patent as collateral...

TextContext.SourceString: 稍等一下！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hold your horses!

TextContext.SourceString: 前、前辈？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yes, Navigator?

TextContext.SourceString: （说到交易……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Speaking of deals...)

TextContext.SourceString: 上次的跳舞机测试……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Remember when I tested your arcade machine?

TextContext.SourceString: 我还没给你反馈呢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I haven't provided feedback to you.

TextContext.SourceString: 有意思，那你就说说看？
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm listening.

TextContext.SourceString: 游戏的难度太高了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The game is too difficult.

TextContext.SourceString: 还以为你要说什么呢……不就是在给自己找借口？
TextContext.LocalizedString: I thought you were going to tell me something interesting... Make excuses much?

TextContext.SourceString: 我看你还是好好练练再来锐评吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Get better at the game before running your mouth.

TextContext.SourceString: 不对，所谓的游戏……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I disagree. Games...

TextContext.SourceString: 应该要让更多人玩才有意义。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Are supposed to be enjoyed by all players.

TextContext.SourceString: 你的意思是……
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're saying that...

TextContext.SourceString: 哈哈哈，有意思！你说的有道理！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ha-ha-ha! Interesting! You have a valid point!

TextContext.SourceString: 不错，引航者，这条建议值得相应的价值。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Not bad, Navigator. This is valuable advice.

TextContext.SourceString: 咦，什么？前辈，你在和白墨先生打什么哑谜？
TextContext.LocalizedString: I don't follow. Was that a riddle, Navigator?

TextContext.SourceString: 什么哑谜，我没有啊？
TextContext.LocalizedString: No, you're overthinking it.

TextContext.SourceString: 我只是在说游戏而已……
TextContext.LocalizedString: We were talking about the game...

TextContext.SourceString: 好，我给你们一个机会把奥黛丽带回来。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Very well. I'll give you a chance to bring Audrey back.

TextContext.SourceString: 你知道她在哪？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You know where she is?

TextContext.SourceString: 巧了，我还真就知道——
TextContext.LocalizedString: As a matter of fact, I do.

TextContext.SourceString: 奥黛丽她，独自前往了欧拉港口……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Audrey went to Port Euler alone...

TextContext.SourceString: 并且，在那里与一个戴兜帽的女人见面了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: And met with a hooded woman there.
What?!

TextContext.SourceString: 这个答案，和你们想的一样吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Is this the answer you expected?

TextContext.SourceString: （乌尔比诺总部大楼附近。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Near Urbino HQ.)

TextContext.SourceString: （不起眼的小巷中，隐隐能听到广场上聚集的人群发出的嘈杂声音。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (In an inconspicuous alley, the sounds of the crowd gathered in the square nearby can be heard.)

TextContext.SourceString: 迷路的蝴蝶，被花朵吸引了吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Were you attracted by flowers, my lost butterfly?

TextContext.SourceString: “大艺术家”。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The Great Artist.

TextContext.SourceString: 特别观察对象，危险度：S。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Special observation subject. Danger level: S.

TextContext.SourceString: 依据情报，判定为新伯利恒的重要人物。
TextContext.LocalizedString: An important member of New Bethlehem, according to intel.

TextContext.SourceString: 涉嫌策划及实施多起恐怖袭击事件。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Suspected of planning and executing multiple terrorist attacks.

TextContext.SourceString: 煽动人心，制造混乱，欣赏他人的丑态……真是幼稚的兴趣呢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Inciting the public, wreaking havoc, enjoying others' disgraces... What a bunch of childish interests.

TextContext.SourceString: ……你竟然说是丑态？
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...Disgrace?

TextContext.SourceString: 我不过是让人们释放了内心的渴望，挥洒出最诚挚的感性……
TextContext.LocalizedString: All I do is let people show their true selves, expressing their most sincere sensibilities...

TextContext.SourceString: 要说这是“丑态”的话，在你看来人类的感情本身就是丑陋的吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: If you consider this to be a “disgrace”, do you believe that all human emotions are innately disgraceful?

TextContext.SourceString: 原来如此……我似乎稍微了解你这个人了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I see... I'm getting to know you better.

TextContext.SourceString: 就这么得出结论真的好吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Is it a bit too soon to come to a conclusion?

TextContext.SourceString: 也许，你看到的只是我想让你看到的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Perhaps you've only seen what I want you to see.

TextContext.SourceString: 哦？是这样吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Is that so?

TextContext.SourceString: 习惯了用假象欺骗别人，可不要连自己都欺骗了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Have you been deceiving others for so long that you've even fooled yourself?

TextContext.SourceString: 更加诚实一点吧，就算是我的忠告。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Be honest. Take this as my advice.

TextContext.SourceString: 那么，我还有一场重要的约会，请允许我就此告辞。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Anyway, I have a date. So long.

TextContext.SourceString: 那个约会的对象——是奥黛丽·格罗夫吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Is it with Audrey Grove?

TextContext.SourceString: （金铁交击，迸发出耀眼的火花。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Sparks fly as their weapons clash.)

TextContext.SourceString: （拔刀，踏步，斩击。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (She unsheathes her sword, takes a fighting stance, and strikes.)

TextContext.SourceString: （行云流水般的动作几乎以肉眼无法捕捉的速度在一瞬间完成。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Her smooth moves are completed in an instant at a speed almost imperceptible to the naked eye.)

TextContext.SourceString: （但是，“大艺术家”也以同样的速度用随身的武器进行了格挡。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (At the same time, The Great Artist takes out her weapon and parries Flavia's attacks equally fast.)

TextContext.SourceString: （动作算不上洗炼，没有经过系统的战斗训练。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Her moves suggest that she has not been properly trained for combat.)

TextContext.SourceString: （是单纯凭直觉和反应做到的吗？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Was that purely based on instinct and reaction?)

TextContext.SourceString: 真过分啊，竟然逼我拿出了武器。
TextContext.LocalizedString: How rude. You made me draw my weapon.

TextContext.SourceString: 单纯的暴力可不符合我的美学。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Violence doesn't match my aesthetics.

TextContext.SourceString: 这种挨打的活，应该交给拉法才对。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The beating should be left to Rafa.

TextContext.SourceString: 回答我的问题。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Answer my question.

TextContext.SourceString: 对，你猜的没错——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yes, you're right.

TextContext.SourceString: “钢铁的独角兽”，从一开始就是我等的盟友。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The Steel Unicorn has always been my ally.

TextContext.SourceString: 格罗夫集团正是在新伯利恒的支援下，干掉所有竞争对手，成功登上常任理事的席位。
TextContext.LocalizedString: With the support of New Bethlehem, Grove Enterprises took down all its competitors and ascended to the position of permanent director.

TextContext.SourceString: 而格罗夫银行事件，不过是我们一起演出的一场好戏。
TextContext.LocalizedString: As for the Grove Bank Incident, it was merely a show, aimed at fooling all of you.

TextContext.SourceString: 怎么样，这是你想要的答案吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Is this the answer you wanted to hear?

TextContext.SourceString: 不喜欢的话我还可以换一个。
TextContext.LocalizedString: If not, I could give you another one.

TextContext.SourceString: 我问的是——“奥黛丽·格罗夫”！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm asking you about Audrey Grove!

TextContext.SourceString: 自从受到崩溃症的影响而失忆之后，奥黛丽和格罗夫集团的行为就发生了巨大的变化。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ever since she suffered from amnesia as a result of collapse syndrome, her and Grove Enterprises' actions have drastically changed.

TextContext.SourceString: 无论过去的她与新伯利恒是否有联系，如今的奥黛丽·格罗夫都没有与此相关的迹象。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Regardless of her past connections with New Bethlehem, the new Audrey is no longer associated with the organization.

TextContext.SourceString: 为什么新伯利恒要帮助一个已经与你们无关的人夺取乌尔比诺的盟主？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Why would New Bethlehem help an outsider take over as the leader of Urbino?

TextContext.SourceString: （再一次交锋，刀刃与枪身绞合在一起，发出刺耳的倾轧声。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Their weapons clash again, producing a grating screech.)

TextContext.SourceString: 如果我说……新伯利恒找到了治愈崩溃症、找回失去记忆的方法呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What if New Bethlehem has found the cure for collapse syndrome, a way to regain lost memories?

TextContext.SourceString: （虽然只有短短的一瞬，但“大艺术家”所说的可能性让芙拉薇娅产生了些微的迟疑。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (For an instant, Flavia hesitates as she ponders what The Great Artist has said.)

TextContext.SourceString: （“大艺术家”没有放过这短短的空隙，敏捷地从芙拉薇娅的缠斗中挣脱出来。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The Great Artist, on the other hand, seizes the opportunity and breaks free from the fight.)

TextContext.SourceString: 刚才的话……是真的吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Is this true?

TextContext.SourceString: 如果是真的会怎样？是假的又如何？
TextContext.LocalizedString: So what if it is? And what if it's not?

TextContext.SourceString: （“大艺术家”的手中突然像变魔术一般出现了一沓扑克牌。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The Great Artist produces a deck of playing cards as if she is a magician.)

TextContext.SourceString: （她将纸牌轻轻掷出。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (She gently tosses the cards.)

TextContext.SourceString: （纸牌竟然变化成了一个个和“大艺术家”毫无二致的人形分身。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The cards transform into several clones of The Great Artist.)

TextContext.SourceString: ……麻烦的能力。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...What a troublesome ability.

TextContext.SourceString: 我记住你了，“复眼”的蝴蝶小姐。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I will remember you, Lady Butterfly of the Compound Eye.
