TextContext.SourceString: 你就继续戴着那副假面吧，总有一天我会把它完全剥落下来。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Keep wearing that mask of yours. One day, I will strip it piece by piece.

TextContext.SourceString: 我很期待，看到那副假面之下的真实的你……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I look forward to seeing the real you beneath the mask...

TextContext.SourceString: 一定，会非常美丽吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: It must be beautiful.

TextContext.SourceString: （在抛下这些话之后，“大艺术家”的所有分身开始同时朝着不同方向离开。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (After making their speeches, all of The Great Artist's clones begin to leave in different directions simultaneously.)

TextContext.SourceString: （这些分身拥有极为精巧的设计，即使以芙拉薇娅的眼力也无法在短时间内分辨。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The clones are intricately designed, indistinguishable even to someone as keen as Flavia.)

TextContext.SourceString: （判断为难以追击的芙拉薇娅，放弃了无谓地消耗体力。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Realizing that it would be extremely difficult to pursue the real target, Flavia gives up to conserve energy.)

TextContext.SourceString: 要抓住她，棋子还不够吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: A pawn would be more than enough to capture her.

TextContext.SourceString: （此时，小巷中又出现了新的脚步声。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Suddenly, new footsteps are heard in the alley.)

TextContext.SourceString: 什么人！举起手来！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Who goes there? Freeze!

TextContext.SourceString: 在这种地方鬼鬼祟祟的……还拿着武器……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Sneaking around... while armed...

TextContext.SourceString: 我们听到战斗的声音才会过来。
TextContext.LocalizedString: We heard the sounds of fighting and came straight over.

TextContext.SourceString: 可以请你跟我们回局里解释一下吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Could you please come back to the station with us?

TextContext.SourceString: 你们……应该是搜查局的？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Are you... from the Bureau of Investigation?

TextContext.SourceString: 对了，就这么办吧……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Very well...

TextContext.SourceString: 你在嘀咕什么，快把武器放下！
TextContext.LocalizedString: What are you muttering about? Lay down your weapon!

TextContext.SourceString: 诶？你在掏什么！？再不停下我就开枪了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Eh? What are you reaching for? Stop, or I'll shoot!

TextContext.SourceString: 等等，米雪儿！那是——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Wait, Michele! That's...

TextContext.SourceString: （芙拉薇娅拿出的是绘有欧泊徽章的所属证明。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Flavia has produced a PUS badge.)

TextContext.SourceString: （上面的部队番号是一个米雪儿不熟悉的号码——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The unit number on the badge is unfamiliar to Michele.)

TextContext.SourceString: 你是复眼的……？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're with the Compound Eye...

TextContext.SourceString: 行动副队长，芙拉薇娅。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Deputy Commander Flavia.

TextContext.SourceString: 现在，基于复眼部队的独立指挥权，现地征召你们两人加入特别行动小队。
TextContext.LocalizedString: By the independent authority of the Compound Eye, I hereby conscript you two into the Spec Ops squad.

TextContext.SourceString: 从现在起，你们听我指挥。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're under my command from now on.
Eh?
(At an unknown location)

TextContext.SourceString: 你真的来了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're here!

TextContext.SourceString: 我还以为那个大艺术家又在耍我呢……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I thought The Great Artist was messing with me again...

TextContext.SourceString: 不好意思，上次没能和你打个招呼。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I didn't have time to say hi last time. Sorry about that.

TextContext.SourceString: 奥黛丽大小姐不会怪我吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You won't blame me, Lady Audrey, would you?

TextContext.SourceString: （奥黛丽谨慎地踏入了这个空间，扫视着周围的环境，露出了不快的神情。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Audrey carefully enters the room, glancing around while looking annoyed.)

TextContext.SourceString: （这里的建筑结构、物品摆设……都与格罗夫银行的保险室别无二致。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The structure and the arrangement of items are almost identical to Grove Bank's vault.)

TextContext.SourceString: （其中的意义不言自明——这是为了那场袭击所准备的演习场。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The implication is clear - it is a practice room used to rehearse the attack.)

TextContext.SourceString: （而邀请她来到这里的，正是袭击的主犯——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The person who has invited her here is none other than the mastermind behind the attack.)

TextContext.SourceString: 就是你吗？在我家银行开了个大洞的人？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Are you the one who blew up my bank?

TextContext.SourceString: 不客气。你家的保险室太久没打扫了，一股霉味，我只是帮忙通通气。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're welcome. Your vault hadn't been cleaned for a while and smelled of mold. I was just helping you air it out.

TextContext.SourceString: 那看来，我可得“好好”谢谢你。
TextContext.LocalizedString: In that case, I should properly thank you.

TextContext.SourceString: 要打吗？我倒是无所谓……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Want to fight? I'm fine with that...

TextContext.SourceString: 毕竟，你不是我的对手。
TextContext.LocalizedString: After all, you're no match for me.

TextContext.SourceString: （要不是这样，我也不会接这个活了……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Otherwise, I wouldn't have accepted this job...)

TextContext.SourceString: 哼，别太得意……今天先放过你。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Humph. Don't be arrogant... I'll let you off this time.

TextContext.SourceString: 告诉我，你、还有你背后的组织——你们到底是谁？有什么目的？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Tell me. You and the organization you work for - who are you people? What do you want?

TextContext.SourceString: “新伯利恒”，和“拉法”。
TextContext.LocalizedString: My name is Rafa. The organization is called New Bethlehem.

TextContext.SourceString: 目前来说，能告诉你的只有这些。
TextContext.LocalizedString: That's all I can tell you for now.

TextContext.SourceString: 那么我们可以开始谈正事了吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Can we get to business now?

TextContext.SourceString: 毫无诚意，这样我们可没法谈。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You've shown no positive intention. We can't talk business like this.

TextContext.SourceString: 彼此彼此吧？可以把你的录音器收一收吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: And neither have you. Could you turn off the audio recorder now?
Humph...

TextContext.SourceString: （对方早有准备，奥黛丽也放弃了依靠任何小手段的想法。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Seeing as the other party has come prepared, Audrey gives up on pulling any tricks.)

TextContext.SourceString: （她当着拉法的面，取出了别在身上的隐藏录音器，并且把身上能够隐藏物品的角落都展示给对方看。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (She removes her hidden recording device and shows Rafa that there are no more hidden items on her.)

TextContext.SourceString: 很聪明。
TextContext.LocalizedString: That's a smart move.

TextContext.SourceString: 不管你想留下任何“证据”，或是传出任何“情报”，会惹上麻烦的都是你自己。
TextContext.LocalizedString: No matter what evidence you want to leave behind or any information you want to leak, you'd end up being the one in trouble.

TextContext.SourceString: 欧泊之眼已经盯上你了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The Eye of P.U.S is watching you.

TextContext.SourceString: 你也不想和“组织”接触的事情被大家知道吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You don't want people to find out that you have been in contact with the organization, do you?

TextContext.SourceString: 在这里的谈话可以放心，任何信号都传不出去。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You can speak freely. No signal gets through these walls.

TextContext.SourceString: 少说废话，我可没同意和你们合作。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Cut to the chase. I haven't agreed to cooperate with you.

TextContext.SourceString: 是“还”没有……我相信我们提供的条件足够让你接受。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Not yet... I believe I can make you an offer you can't refuse.

TextContext.SourceString: 你们……真的可以帮格罗夫渡过危机吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Can you... really help Grove Enterprises survive the crisis?

TextContext.SourceString: 不是“渡过危机”……而是帮助你当上乌尔比诺的盟主。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Not only that... We'll even make you the leader of Urbino.

TextContext.SourceString: 邮件上已经说得很清楚了，你也是为此而来的吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: I've explained everything in the email. That must be why you're here, no?

TextContext.SourceString: 说得轻松……格罗夫集团光是应对眼前的问题就已经捉襟见肘，一群见不得光的鼠辈又能做什么？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Easy for you to say... We are already stretched thin dealing with the current issues. What can a bunch of wannabe spies do for me?

TextContext.SourceString: 你明明已经见识过新伯利恒的手段了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: You've seen what New Bethlehem is capable of...

TextContext.SourceString: 只要有那个意思，我们甚至可以随时在纽特朗掀起一场逆弦化风暴。
TextContext.LocalizedString: If we want to, we can even initiate a Reverstring Storm in Neutroville at a moment's notice.

TextContext.SourceString: 风暴……该不会！？
TextContext.LocalizedString: A storm... Wait a second!

TextContext.SourceString: 没错，安置炸弹阵列炸毁科摩斯塔的——是我们。
TextContext.LocalizedString: That's right. We planted the bombs that destroyed Komos Tower.

TextContext.SourceString: 剪刀手可没有这个胆量。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The Scissors dared not to do that.

TextContext.SourceString: 竟然……
TextContext.LocalizedString: You...

TextContext.SourceString: 这下你相信了吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Do you believe me?

TextContext.SourceString: 不信也没关系，我们还给你准备了另外一个“见面礼”。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's fine if you don't. We've prepared another welcome gift for you.

TextContext.SourceString: 这个时候现在应该已经送到了吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: It should have been delivered by now.

TextContext.SourceString: 什么见面礼！？你们做了什么？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What are you talking about? What have you done?

TextContext.SourceString: 行了，别摆那张臭脸了，这件事对你没坏处。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Enough with your sour face. You'll stand to benefit from it.

TextContext.SourceString: 要让你当上盟主，就得先把那个街舞男拉下马对吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: In order to make you the leader, we first have to take down that dancer.

TextContext.SourceString: 你们该不会要去炸白氏集团的大楼吧！？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're not going to blow up the Bai Group, are you?!

TextContext.SourceString: 放心，这次没有爆炸，没有子弹，也不会有人受伤。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Relax. No explosions or bullets this time. No one will get hurt.

TextContext.SourceString: 我们只是整理了你在乌尔比诺骂过白墨的话，剪辑成了一个大合集而已。
TextContext.LocalizedString: All we've done is compiling every negative thing you've said to Bai Mo in Urbino into a collection.

TextContext.SourceString: 让纽特朗的老百姓看看乌尔比诺盟主不务正业的真面目，你不乐意吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's time for the citizens of Neutroville to see the true face of that irresponsible leader. Wouldn't you like that?

TextContext.SourceString: 我从来没想过用这种手段来打败他！
TextContext.LocalizedString: It was never my intention to take him down with such despicable methods!

TextContext.SourceString: 而且……虽然不想承认，但白墨是个商业天才。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Besides... as much as I hate to admit it, Bai Mo is a business genius.

TextContext.SourceString: 他只用一天的时间就能处理我一个星期的工作，只做最必要的工作，就能让整个乌尔比诺平稳运作。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It only takes him a single day to handle work that would take me a whole week. By doing only the strictly necessary tasks, he keeps the entire alliance running smoothly.

TextContext.SourceString: 只用“不务正业”来评价他，实在太不公平了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's simply unfair to refer to him as “irresponsible”!

TextContext.SourceString: 奇怪，我还以为你很讨厌他呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: How peculiar. I thought you hated him.

TextContext.SourceString: 啊，没错，我最讨厌他那个吊儿郎当的样子了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're right about that. I absolutely detest his carefree attitude.

TextContext.SourceString: 所以我才要用最正当的方式打败他！
TextContext.LocalizedString: That's why I have to defeat him in the most legitimate way!

TextContext.SourceString: 用这种歪门邪道……就算赢了又有什么意义？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Victory through such an underhanded trick is not victory at all!

TextContext.SourceString: 事到如今你还要装成一个乖宝宝吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Don't you think it's time for you to get off your high horse?

TextContext.SourceString: 在你决定接受我们的邀请时，真的一点都没想过会发生什么吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Did you really not expect this would happen when you accepted our invitation?

TextContext.SourceString: 你真的觉得存在什么“正当”的方法可以扭转格罗夫的败局吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Do you truly believe that you can save Grove Enterprises via legitimate means?

TextContext.SourceString: 现在，白氏集团应该正在为应对舆论焦头烂额。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The Bai Group should be overwhelmed trying to deal with public opinion as we speak.

TextContext.SourceString: 只要再点上一把火……将格罗夫银行事件的责任推给白墨……
TextContext.LocalizedString: All you have to do is rub a little more salt into the wound... Shift the blame for the Grove Bank Incident to Bai Mo...

TextContext.SourceString: 格罗夫集团就能从所有负面舆论中脱身，摇身一变成为可怜的受害者。
TextContext.LocalizedString: And then, Grove Enterprises shall be free from all the negative publicity and reborn as the victim.

TextContext.SourceString: 新伯利恒为你设计的这个结局，你有什么不满吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Are you not satisfied with New Bethlehem's plan?

TextContext.SourceString: 不行。
TextContext.LocalizedString: No.

TextContext.SourceString: 只有这一点，我绝不同意！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I cannot agree to this!

TextContext.SourceString: 传播流言也就算了，我绝对不会帮你们制造谣言，无中生有！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Spreading rumors is one thing, but I will not help you fabricate lies out of nothing!

TextContext.SourceString: 更何况，制造事件的不就是你们吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Besides, isn't New Bethlehem the mastermind behind all of this?

TextContext.SourceString: （你到底在做什么，奥黛丽？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (What are you doing, Audrey?)

TextContext.SourceString: （你怎么会期待新伯利恒这样的人会有什么正当的手段……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (How could you expect New Bethlehem to resort to legitimate means...)

TextContext.SourceString: 不好意思，交易取消。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Sorry. The deal is canceled.

TextContext.SourceString: 让我过去。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Let me through.

TextContext.SourceString: 啧……结果还是变成这样了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Tsk... After all our efforts, it still ended up this way.

TextContext.SourceString: 朱利安，动手。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Do it, Giuliano.
...What?

TextContext.SourceString: （从奥黛丽的视野死角，早在谈话开始之前就潜伏于此的刺客，射出了一枚装有紫色液体的注射弹头。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The assassin, who has been hidden in a dark corner long before the conversation started, fires a syringe dart filled with a purple liquid from Audrey's blind spot.)

TextContext.SourceString: （意料之外的攻击让奥黛丽来不及躲避，注射弹准确地命中了她的颈动脉。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Caught off guard, Audrey fails to dodge in time as the dart hits her carotid artery.)
Ugh!

TextContext.SourceString: （奥黛丽反射性地伸出手，想要拔出针头。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Audrey reflexively reaches for the dart, trying to remove it.)

TextContext.SourceString: （从阴影中走出的少年从背后钳制住了奥黛丽的双手。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The young man steps out of the shadows and restrains Audrey from behind.)

TextContext.SourceString: 别乱动，奥黛丽姐姐。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Stay still, Audrey.

TextContext.SourceString: 哈……真是自作自受啊，奥黛丽·格罗夫。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ha-ha... You've brought this upon yourself, Audrey Grove.

TextContext.SourceString: 明明给了你那么多选择，你却自己选了最遭罪的那条。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Of all the choices, you just had to choose the one where you'd suffer the most.

TextContext.SourceString: 放开我！你们到底给我打了什么东西……！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Let me go! What was in that thing...

TextContext.SourceString: “现在”的你实在太麻烦了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're too troublesome in your current state.

TextContext.SourceString: 与其在这里和你浪费口舌，还是先“回归出厂设置”一次吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Rather than wasting my breath with you now, let's reset you to your factory settings first.

TextContext.SourceString: 什么！？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Eh?!

TextContext.SourceString: （眼前的一切开始溶解，剥离。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Everything before Audrey begins to become blurry.)

TextContext.SourceString: （不断纠缠，近乎让人感到癫狂。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Her visions intertwine, driving her to madness.)

TextContext.SourceString: （灼热的伤痕一条条绽开，而某种记忆和感情也在逐渐被剥离。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The burning scars burst open one by one as her memories and emotions are gradually stripped away.)

TextContext.SourceString: 朱█安，放开█吧，█已经没█抵抗的力█了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Let █ go, Giuliano. ██ can't ████ resist.

TextContext.SourceString: （眼前的人影变得扭曲，话语也开始撕裂。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The figure before Audrey becomes distorted, their words tearing apart.)

TextContext.SourceString: 怎█样？熟悉█？
TextContext.LocalizedString: How ██ it ██? Familiar ██?

TextContext.SourceString: （灼痕向着意识的深处延伸、挖掘，穿透大脑，直抵灵魂。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The scorching scars dig deep into her consciousness, piercing through her mind and reaching her soul.)

TextContext.SourceString: 啊，█可能连这█感█也一起忘█——
TextContext.LocalizedString: ███ might have forgotten ████ feels ██...

TextContext.SourceString: 崩溃症。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Collapse syndrome.
Ah... Urh!

TextContext.SourceString: 为什么……怎么可能……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Why... How...

TextContext.SourceString: 人为制造……崩溃……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Create... collapse...

TextContext.SourceString: （奥黛丽匍匐在地，艰难地抵抗着刺穿全身的痛楚。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Crawling on the ground, Audrey struggles against the pain piercing through her entire body.)

TextContext.SourceString: （但是更为难耐的绝非身体的痛苦。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (But the physical torment is not the hardest to bear.)

TextContext.SourceString: （随着崩溃症的发生，记录着“奥黛丽”这一存在的弦序列正在发生极速崩解。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (With the onset of collapse syndrome, the string sequences that record the very existence of Audrey rapidly disintegrate like a dying star collapsing on itself.)

TextContext.SourceString: 可恶，别过来……！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Damn it. Go away...

TextContext.SourceString: 不准、再、入侵……我的——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Stop. Invading. My...

TextContext.SourceString: （一张张陌生的脸孔，一段段陌生的时光——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Faces unfamiliar. Memories unknown...)

TextContext.SourceString: ……德尔、威廉……赛妮斯……
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...Del, William... Cynis...

TextContext.SourceString: 这些都是……什么？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What is this...

TextContext.SourceString: 你们是……谁……？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Who are you...
...Navigator?

TextContext.SourceString: 必须……告诉……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I must... tell...

TextContext.SourceString: 啊？你居然还有意识吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Huh? You're still conscious?

TextContext.SourceString: 别再挣扎了，长痛不如短痛。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Stop struggling. You're only making it worse for yourself.

TextContext.SourceString: 老实接受这个事实吧——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Accept the reality.

TextContext.SourceString: 你的意识会被崩溃症摧毁，然后在新伯利恒的设施里接受轮回，重新变回一张白纸。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Collapse syndrome will destroy your consciousness. You will be reincarnated at the New Bethlehem facility and start anew.

TextContext.SourceString: 到那时候，我们再来重新谈谈合作的事吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Perhaps then, we can resume our negotiation.

TextContext.SourceString: 唔——想得、美！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ugh... In your dreams!

TextContext.SourceString: （从表意识开始，深入到潜意识、最后是无意识——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Starting from her consciousness, delving into her subconsciousness and then unconsciousness...)

TextContext.SourceString: （崩溃的触角不加区分地将构成“奥黛丽”的一切拉扯出来，展现在她面前——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: The tentacles of collapse syndrome indiscriminately pull out everything that constitutes Audrey, laying them in front of her...)

TextContext.SourceString: （缓慢地……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Slowly...)

TextContext.SourceString: （撕扯着……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Tearing...)

TextContext.SourceString: （记忆的丝线逐渐紧绷、断裂……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The threads of memory tighten, snap...)

TextContext.SourceString: （一根、接着一根……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (One by one...)

TextContext.SourceString: （直到……勉强连接着的最后一根丝线……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Until... the last one hangs by a thread...)
No!!! Stop!!!

TextContext.SourceString: （欧拉港口，外围。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Outside Port Euler)

TextContext.SourceString: 确认到奥黛丽与新伯利恒接触……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I have confirmed that Audrey has made contact with New Bethlehem...

TextContext.SourceString: 到底在谈什么？天色都暗下来了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: What are they talking about? It's late already...

TextContext.SourceString: 按老板的指示，守住出入口……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Guarding the entrance as instructed by the boss...

TextContext.SourceString: 真的没问题吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Is everything alright?

TextContext.SourceString: 继续等待？还是……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Should I keep waiting or...
Hmm...

TextContext.SourceString: 有什么……烧焦的气味？
TextContext.LocalizedString: I smell something burning.

TextContext.SourceString: （巨大的爆焰掀飞了物流仓库的闸门。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A massive explosive blows the gate off the warehouse.)

TextContext.SourceString: （灼热的火舌瞬间将周围的货物点燃，将周围化为了一片火海。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The raging flames ignite the surrounding goods, turning the building into an inferno.)

TextContext.SourceString: （戴兜帽的女性和另一个少年的身影从火焰中狼狈地跌出。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A hooded girl and a young man tumble out of the burning warehouse.)

TextContext.SourceString: 咳咳咳……！！
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Coughing...)

TextContext.SourceString: 喂！朱利安！这是怎么回事！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hey! Julian! What the heck happened back there?

TextContext.SourceString: 那个女人不是已经被崩溃症完全侵蚀了吗！？怎么突然发起疯了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Wasn't she completely consumed by collapse syndrome? How did she go berserk all of a sudden?

TextContext.SourceString: 看来……崩溃症解开了她的理性枷锁，让她发挥出了比平常更强的战斗力。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It would appear that... collapse syndrome unlocked the shackles of her rationality, granting her more powerful strength than usual.

TextContext.SourceString: 真是稀有的案例，她的心里关着一头不得了的怪物啊。
TextContext.LocalizedString: What a rare case. She's got a terrible monster locked inside of her all this time.

TextContext.SourceString: 现在怎么办！我们还得把她带回新伯利恒吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What do we do now? We have to take her back to New Bethlehem, don't we?

TextContext.SourceString: 那当然是——交给你啦，拉法姐姐。我就先撤了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: We're going to... leave it to you, Rafa! See you.

TextContext.SourceString: 等等，朱利安！你要留我一个跟那个怪物打吗！？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Wait, Julian! You're leaving me alone with that monster?

TextContext.SourceString: 是谁信誓旦旦地说“你不是我的对手”来着？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Didn't you say she was no match for you?

TextContext.SourceString: 啊对了，要是这次再失败的话，启示者老师可是会生气的哦？
TextContext.LocalizedString: By the way, should you fail again, the Revelator is going to be furious.

TextContext.SourceString: 别走！都叫你等等啦！帮我想想办法！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Stop! Don't go! Help me out!

TextContext.SourceString: 那两个人，逃走了？奥黛丽呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Did they just run away? Where is Audrey?

TextContext.SourceString: 预想外的情况……老板的预案里可没包括这个。
TextContext.LocalizedString: This is unexpected... This isn't mentioned in the boss's contingency plan.

TextContext.SourceString: 那是……有人出来了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Wait... Someone's coming out!

TextContext.SourceString: 需要确认——
TextContext.LocalizedString: I need to confirm...

TextContext.SourceString: （烈焰之中，高贵的独角兽踏着火焰缓步而出。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A noble unicorn gracefully steps out of a sea of fire.)

TextContext.SourceString: （在她的对面，是准备好露出尖牙的猎杀者。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Across from her is a hunter, ready to bare its fangs.)

TextContext.SourceString: 到底是怎么回事，奥黛丽·格罗夫？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What is going on with you, Audrey Grove?

TextContext.SourceString: 现在的你，是乌尔比诺的敌人，还是盟友？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Are you an enemy or an ally of Urbino?

TextContext.SourceString: 视你的回答而定——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Your fate depends on your answer...

TextContext.SourceString: 别、妨碍我——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Don't get in my way...

TextContext.SourceString: 要战吗？那么……
TextContext.LocalizedString: You want to fight? In that case...

TextContext.SourceString: 我来送你上路吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'll put you six feet under!

TextContext.SourceString: 格罗夫的独角兽。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The Unicorn Grove.

TextContext.SourceString: 我一直……都想像这样和你厮杀一次。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I've always wanted to... fight you like this.

TextContext.SourceString: 猎物一直在眼前晃荡的感觉，你能懂吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Have you any idea what it feels like to have your prey in your sight all the time?

TextContext.SourceString: 咕——别、妨碍我——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ah... Get out of my way...
No one... shall stop me!

TextContext.SourceString: （此时的奥黛丽，正以不同以往的疯狂姿态摧毁着眼前的一切。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Audrey is destroying everything before her in an unprecedented frenzy.)

TextContext.SourceString: （她用左手持榴弹发射器，右手持机枪，同时操纵两把武器进行战斗。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Wielding a grenade launcher in her left hand and a machine gun in her right, she fires both weapons in combat.)

TextContext.SourceString: （枪弹、爆炸与火焰，一刻不停地交替向绯莎袭去。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Bullets, explosions, and flames form a tremendous onslaught against Fuchsia.)

TextContext.SourceString: （被奥黛丽猛烈的攻击逼退，绯莎只得暂时栖身进入了集装箱的阴影之中。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Unable to resist Audrey's fierce attacks, Fuchsia takes refuge in the shadows of shipping containers.)

TextContext.SourceString: 真是乱来的战斗方式……
TextContext.LocalizedString: What a chaotic strategy...

TextContext.SourceString: 与其说是独角兽，更像是受伤的狮子。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Rather than a unicorn, she's more like a wounded lioness.

TextContext.SourceString: 但，这样才有狩猎的价值。
TextContext.LocalizedString: But this is precisely what makes the hunt valuable.

TextContext.SourceString: （绯莎拿出了随身携带的战术面具，毫不犹豫地将其覆盖在脸上。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Fuchsia takes out a tactical mask and puts it on without any hesitation.)

TextContext.SourceString: （雾化器喷出的晶体粉末随着绯莎的呼吸钻入鼻腔，融入血液。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The atomizer sprays crystalline powder that enters Fuchsia's nostrils as she breathes, entering her bloodstream.)
(Lub-dub!)

TextContext.SourceString: （伴随着心脏的鼓动，一股强大的电流过遍全身。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As her heart beats, a powerful surge of current flows through her body.)

TextContext.SourceString: （绯莎的每一条血管、每一根神经、每一个毛孔都随之偾张，全身的感知能力与反应速度都提升至极限。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Every vein, nerve, and pore in her body expands, enhancing her sensory perception and reaction speed to the limit.)

TextContext.SourceString: （此时的她，即使不用眼睛也能感知战场的一切，她与战场一同呼吸。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Breathing as one with the battlefield, she perceives everything that is happening without having to look.)

TextContext.SourceString: 猎鲨模式，启动！
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Hunting Shark Mode, activate!)

TextContext.SourceString: （绷紧全身的肌肉，全力踩踏地面，如同一道闪电般射出——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Her muscles tense, she stomps the ground with full force and shoots out like a bolt of lightning.)

TextContext.SourceString: （绯红色的闪电以奥黛丽为中心，在掩体之间飞速绕行，甚至将奥黛丽的机枪喷出的火线远远地甩在了身后。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The crimson lightning circles Audrey, swiftly maneuvering between covers, leaving the trail of bullets shot by Audrey far behind.)

TextContext.SourceString: （齿锋在她的手中如同一把精准而敏捷的猎刀，不断从掩体的间隙中向奥黛丽的死角射出枪弹。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (In her hand, the Sawtooth is like an accurate and agile hunting knife, continuously firing bullets through gaps in covers toward Audrey's blind spots.)

TextContext.SourceString: （就这样，消耗猎物的体力——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I need to keep it up and deplete the prey's stamina.)
Ugh!

TextContext.SourceString: （被绯莎的行为激怒的奥黛丽，不再使用机枪进行射击，而是举起了左手的榴弹发射器——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Enraged by Fuchsia's actions, Audrey stops firing her machine gun and raises the grenade launcher in her left hand.)

TextContext.SourceString: （向着绯莎即将闪身进入的下一个掩体。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Audrey fires at the next cover Fuchsia is about to hide behind.)

TextContext.SourceString: （爆炸和火焰掀起了数米高的烟尘。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The explosions and the flames kick up a cloud of dust several meters high.)

TextContext.SourceString: （倒下的瓦砾之中——露出了绯莎的半截披风……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Among the debris, there is half of Fuchsia's cloak...)
Where is... the enemy?

TextContext.SourceString: 我在——
TextContext.LocalizedString: I am...

TextContext.SourceString: 这里！！！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Right here!!!

TextContext.SourceString: （从半空中跳出的绯莎出现在与刚才完全相反的方向上。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Fuchsia leaps from mid-air, appearing in a completely different direction from where she was before.)

TextContext.SourceString: （她所做的一切都是为了瞄准这一刻。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Everything she did has been preparing for this moment.)

TextContext.SourceString: （猎人与猎物之间再没有任何阻挡，剩下的只有狩猎与被狩猎。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (There are no more barriers between the hunter and the prey. All that remains are the hunt and the hunted.)

TextContext.SourceString: 奥黛丽·格罗夫——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Audrey Grove!

TextContext.SourceString: 你就在这里退场吧！
TextContext.LocalizedString: You will take your leave now!
No!

TextContext.SourceString: （一道晃眼的闪光划破了黑夜。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A dazzling flash cuts through the night.)

TextContext.SourceString: （锐利的刀锋横亘在绯莎的枪口与奥黛丽的心脏之间，击出的子弹被漂亮地一分为二。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A sharp blade lies between Fuchsia's gun and Audrey's heart, splitting the bullet in two.)

TextContext.SourceString: 不准对奥黛丽小姐动手——！！！
TextContext.LocalizedString: You shall not harm Lady Audrey!!!
What?!

TextContext.SourceString: 居然用刀——？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You split the bullet with a sword?

TextContext.SourceString: 我不知道你是谁！但奥黛丽小姐是我重要的朋友！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I don't know who you are, but Lady Audrey is my close friend!

TextContext.SourceString: 战斗不是我的本意，但如果你不愿意退下的话——
TextContext.LocalizedString: I have no intention to fight, but if you don't stand down...

TextContext.SourceString: 碍事！
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're in my way!

TextContext.SourceString: 又一次——！？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Again?!

TextContext.SourceString: 为什么！为什么打不中！？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Why? Why can't I hit her?!

TextContext.SourceString: （星绘一往无前地向着绯莎逼近，所有的子弹都被她轻易地躲过或是用刀劈开。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Celestia advances relentlessly toward Fuchsia, dodging or slicing through all of the latter's shots.)

TextContext.SourceString: （一种异样的感觉刺激着绯莎敏感的神经。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A strange feeling whispers to Fuchsia's sensitive nerves.)

TextContext.SourceString: （仿佛她正与之战斗的并不是眼前的少女，而是某种更加遥远、更加庞大的存在……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As if her opponent is not the girl in front of her, but a far more distant and immense existence...)

TextContext.SourceString: （十米，五米……少女的刀锋即将到达足以触及自己的领域。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Ten meters. Five meters... The girl is almost in range of Fuchsia.)
(I have to dodge...)

TextContext.SourceString: （再一次，像刚才，像闪电一般跑起来！）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I need to run as fast as lightning again!)
(Ugh!)

TextContext.SourceString: （超负荷战斗的反冲，在这时袭击了绯莎。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The side effect of overloaded combat hits Fuchsia.)

TextContext.SourceString: （强烈的撕裂感令绯莎全身的肌肉紧绷，一时间无法做出任何动作。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A strong sensation of tearing causes Fuchsia's muscles to tense, leaving her immobilized.)

TextContext.SourceString: 输了……吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Have I lost?

TextContext.SourceString: （在绯莎倒下的一瞬间，她眼角的余光中，一个造型奇特的手环正发出微微的亮光。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As Fuchsia falls, she catches a glimpse of a uniquely shaped bracelet faintly glowing.)
Phew... Phew... Phew...

TextContext.SourceString: 我……没事吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Am I... okay?

TextContext.SourceString: 刚才的星绘太帅了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: You were amazing, Astierred!

TextContext.SourceString: 我都不知道星绘这么厉害！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I had no idea you were capable of this!

TextContext.SourceString: 刚才……还以为绝对会被打到的……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I thought... surely, I'd be hit...

TextContext.SourceString: 但不知道为什么，那一瞬间，就像是前辈在告诉我敌人会向哪里攻击一样……
TextContext.LocalizedString: But somehow, in that instant, I felt as if you were telling me where the enemy would attack...

TextContext.SourceString: 可是，她是谁？为什么要攻击奥黛丽小姐？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Who is she? Why did she attack Lady Audrey?

TextContext.SourceString: （被星绘打倒的那个女孩，我是不是在哪见过？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The girl Celestia defeated - Have I met her before?)

TextContext.SourceString: 对了！奥黛丽小姐！她在哪！？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Right! Lady Audrey! Where is she?

TextContext.SourceString: 她刚才的样子不太对劲，很像是急性崩溃症的发作症状！必须马上施加治疗！
TextContext.LocalizedString: She seemed like she was experiencing the symptoms of collapse syndrome! She needs immediate medical attention!

TextContext.SourceString: 这家伙，就由我们接收了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: We're happy to take her.

TextContext.SourceString: 新伯利恒的——
TextContext.LocalizedString: New Bethlehem!

TextContext.SourceString: 拉法！？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Rafa?!

TextContext.SourceString: （悄无声息地出现在远处的兜帽少女，用水流裹挟着不断挣扎着的奥黛丽。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The hooded girl appearing out of nowhere wraps the struggling Audrey in a flow of water.)
Ugh... Ugh...

TextContext.SourceString: 奥黛丽小姐！！你快放下她！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Lady Audrey! Put her down right now!

TextContext.SourceString: 这样下去她会被崩溃症——
TextContext.LocalizedString: At this rate, she'll be consumed by collapse syndrome...

TextContext.SourceString: 别担心，新伯利恒会好好“治疗”她的……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Relax. New Bethlehem will heal her...

TextContext.SourceString: 还要谢谢你们让我看了一场好戏。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Thanks for putting on a great show.

TextContext.SourceString: 早知道乌尔比诺这么爱窝里斗的话……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Had I known you people at Urbino were into infighting...

TextContext.SourceString: 我看根本不用新伯利恒出手，你们就会自取灭亡。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You'd have destroyed yourselves without New Bethlehem lifting a finger.

TextContext.SourceString: 也多亏了你们的愚蠢，我才有机会制服这匹发疯的野马。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Thanks to your stupidity, I now have a chance to tame this crazy wild horse.

TextContext.SourceString: 现在，准备跟她说再见吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's time to say goodbye to your friend.

TextContext.SourceString: 咳……别想走！
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Coughing)... You're not going anyway!

TextContext.SourceString: 奥黛丽·格罗夫是我的目标！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Audrey Grove is my target!

TextContext.SourceString: 是你啊……居然还能站起来？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh, you... How are you still standing?

TextContext.SourceString: 真亏你能压制住那种状态下的奥黛丽。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Only you could have gone head-to-head with Audrey in that state.

TextContext.SourceString: 不过，你的身体也快到极限了吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: However, you must be at your limit, no?

TextContext.SourceString: 别想阻止我！
TextContext.LocalizedString: You can't stop me!

TextContext.SourceString: （拉法略一扬手，暗紫色的弦能聚集起来，向着附近倾倒的液体储存罐射去。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As Rafa raises her arm, the dark purple string energy gathers and shoots toward a toppled water tank nearby.)

TextContext.SourceString: 吞噬一切吧，四旬的洪流。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Devour everything, the Flood of Lent.

TextContext.SourceString: （随着拉法的声音，巨大的罐体轰然炸裂，成分不明的溶液奔涌而出，在拉法的操纵下化为一道巨大的水幕。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As Rafa speaks, the massive tank explodes thunderously. The unknown liquid within gushes out, forming a huge water curtain under Rafa's control.)

TextContext.SourceString: （透过水幕的间隙，我注意到了奥黛丽原本浑浊的眼神，在一瞬间恢复了光彩。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Through the gaps in the water, I notice that Audrey's clouded gaze regains clarity in an instant.)
...N-Navigator?

TextContext.SourceString: （随后，水幕倾泻而下，化为了毁灭的洪流。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The water curtain comes pouring down, turning into a flood of destruction.)

TextContext.SourceString: （凶猛的洪流扑灭了火海，卷挟着战场中破碎的残骸向我们席卷而来。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The flood extinguishes the flames, sweeping toward us with the debris of the battlefield.)

TextContext.SourceString: （来不及了——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (We don't have time to get away!)

TextContext.SourceString: 啧……真是麻烦！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Tsk... Such a hassle!

TextContext.SourceString: （一对娇小却强力的手臂将我和星绘同时揽起。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A pair of tiny yet strong arms picks up Astierred and me.)

TextContext.SourceString: （耳边吹过一阵飓风，眼前的景象飞速地倒退。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As a sudden gust of wind blows right next to me, the scene in front of me rapidly retracts.)

TextContext.SourceString: （洪流的轰鸣声逐渐远去，最终汇入了大海的波涛之中。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The roaring flood fades away, eventually merging with the sea.)

TextContext.SourceString: （拉法和奥黛丽，也完全消失在了我们的视野里。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (With it, Rafa and Audrey vanish from our sight.)

TextContext.SourceString: 到这里应该安全了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: We should be safe here.
Ha... Ha...

TextContext.SourceString: （被身份不明的少女扛着飞奔了不知道多久，最终在一个远离港口的地方停了下来。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The mysterious girl has run for who knows how long while carrying us, finally stopping at a location far from the port.)

TextContext.SourceString: （勉强使用超过极限的力量似乎让少女十分疲惫。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Having channeled power beyond her limit, the girl seems exhausted.)

TextContext.SourceString: 那啥，我可以自己走……
TextContext.LocalizedString: By the way, I can walk...

TextContext.SourceString: 哦。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Okay.

TextContext.SourceString: （绯莎举重若轻地将我和星绘放在地上。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Fuchsia puts Celestia and me down as if carrying us all this way has been a piece of cake.)

TextContext.SourceString: 刚才那个还能再表演一次吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Could you do that again?

TextContext.SourceString: （绯莎似乎有些不满地随手把我丢了出去。还好站稳了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Seemingly displeased with my remark, Fuchsia throws me off. Luckily, I manage to land on my feet.)

TextContext.SourceString: （星绘也被轻轻地放了下来。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Then, she gently sets Astierred down.)

TextContext.SourceString: 请问……你到底是谁？
TextContext.LocalizedString: So... Who are you?

TextContext.SourceString: 绯莎，佣兵。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The name's Fuchsia. I'm a mercenary.

TextContext.SourceString: 佣兵？可我不明白，你为什么要救我们？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Mercenary? I don't get it. Why did you save us?

TextContext.SourceString: 我明明都对你挥刀了，你却冒着这么大的危险……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I swung at you. Yet you took a huge risk to...

TextContext.SourceString: 我也对你开枪了。谁也不欠谁。
TextContext.LocalizedString: And I shot at you. We're even.

TextContext.SourceString: 比起那个，告诉我，你是怎么做到的？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Tell me. How did you do it?

TextContext.SourceString: 怎么做到的？什么事？
TextContext.LocalizedString: How did I do what?

TextContext.SourceString: 你为什么能赢过我？明明那么弱……
TextContext.LocalizedString: How did you defeat me? I mean, you seem pretty weak...

TextContext.SourceString: 我讨厌输，所以把赢的方法告诉我。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I hate losing. Tell me how you did it.

TextContext.SourceString: 可能是……运气好吧？绯莎小姐真的很强……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Perhaps... I was just lucky? You're a formidable opponent, Miss Fuchsia...

TextContext.SourceString: （我和星绘刚刚赶到现场的时候，正好目击了绯莎与奥黛丽的战斗。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (When Astierred and I arrived, Fuchsia was fighting Audrey.)

TextContext.SourceString: （单论一对一的接近战能力，她恐怕是我所见过的最强的战士。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (In terms of one-on-one combat, she is probably the strongest fighter I have ever seen.)

TextContext.SourceString: （在星绘冲动之下贸然介入战斗的时候，我的脑海中甚至在一瞬间想象了无数种失败的可能……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (When Astierred impulsively intervened, I thought of countless possibilities of her failure in an instant...)

TextContext.SourceString: （但是，我无视了那些可能性，坚定着相信着星绘能够取胜，一定是这样才创造了奇迹吧——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (However, I ignored all those possibilities, firmly believing that Astierred would win. This must be how the miracle happened...)

TextContext.SourceString: （……真的是这样吗？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (...Or was it?)

TextContext.SourceString: ……不想说吗？那也没关系。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...Cat got your tongue? Never mind.

TextContext.SourceString: 但是……下次，别再妨碍我了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: However... you will not get in my way again.

TextContext.SourceString: （没能得到想要的答案，绯莎头也不回地转身离去。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Unable to get the answer she wants, Fuchsia turns around and walks away.)

TextContext.SourceString: 等等！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Wait!

TextContext.SourceString: 你要去哪？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Where are you going?

TextContext.SourceString: 奥黛丽·格罗夫是我的目标，我不会让其它人偷走我的猎物。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Audrey Grove is my target. I won't allow anyone else to steal my prey.

TextContext.SourceString: 所以，你要和新伯利恒战斗吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Does that mean you will go to war with New Bethlehem?

TextContext.SourceString: 在打败新伯利恒之前，我们目标一致。
TextContext.LocalizedString: We want the same thing. Until New Bethlehem is defeated, anyway.

TextContext.SourceString: 我一个人就可以。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I don't need your help.

TextContext.SourceString: 就凭现在的你，能赢吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Do you really think you stand a chance in your current state?

TextContext.SourceString: 前辈说得对……你的身体已经不允许刚才那样的高强度战斗了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: The Navigator is right... Your body cannot handle another fight as intense as the last one!

TextContext.SourceString: （但老实说，即使加上星绘恐怕也很难有胜算……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (But if I am being honest, even with Celestia's help, they do not stand a chance...)

TextContext.SourceString: 跟我们一起，我有赢的方法。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Come with us. I know how to defeat them.

TextContext.SourceString: 咦……前辈？真的吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Huh... Really, Navigator?

TextContext.SourceString: （不真也得真啊……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (We have no other choice anyway...)

TextContext.SourceString: 那好，我跟你们走。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Fine. I'll come with you.

TextContext.SourceString: 咦……这么快就答应了吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Huh... That's it?

TextContext.SourceString: 老板告诉过我——只要是合理的交易，没有理由不答应。
TextContext.LocalizedString: My boss told me that there is no reason to reject a fair deal.

TextContext.SourceString: 还是说，你们是在骗我？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Or are you lying to me?

TextContext.SourceString: 当然不是！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Of course, not!

TextContext.SourceString: 信我，没问题！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Trust me. I got this!

TextContext.SourceString: 那就走吧，趁他们的气味还没消失。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Let's get going, then, while I can still track them.

TextContext.SourceString: （趁现在拟定策略吧……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Now is the time to come up with a plan...)

TextContext.SourceString: （欧拉港口，新伯利恒行动据点。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (New Bethlehem Operating Base, Port Euler)

TextContext.SourceString: 呀，拉法姐姐~你总算回来了啊。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're back, Rafa!

TextContext.SourceString: ……我把奥黛丽带回来了，这下没话说了吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...I've brought Audrey with me. Are you satisfied now?

TextContext.SourceString: 明明是捡漏的~
TextContext.LocalizedString: You mean you picked her up after the fight was over.

TextContext.SourceString: 行了，快用你的网子把她缠起来。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Enough. Wrap her up with your web.

TextContext.SourceString: 现在虽然晕过去了，要是一会再闹起来可就麻烦了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Do it while she's passed out before she wakes up and causes all sorts of trouble.

TextContext.SourceString: 好好好~
TextContext.LocalizedString: Alright, alright.

TextContext.SourceString: 抓捕不会动的猎物稍微有点无聊就是了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's boring catching prey that doesn't move, that's all...

TextContext.SourceString: （黑发的少年走向了倒在一旁的奥黛丽，轻轻抖动手腕，从身上放出了数只蜘蛛型的小型机器人。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The dark-haired young man approaches Audrey, who is passed out on the floor, and flicks his wrist, releasing multiple spider droids.)

TextContext.SourceString: （蜘蛛落在奥黛丽的四周，在少年的指挥下彼此协作，逐渐织出一张束缚住奥黛丽的蛛网。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The spiders land around Audrey and work under Giuliano's command, weaving a web that binds Audrey.)

TextContext.SourceString: 对了拉法姐姐，你带回来的人，只有奥黛丽一个吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: By the way, Rafa, is she the only one you've brought back?

TextContext.SourceString: 你什么意思？还能有谁？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What do you mean? Who else could there be?

TextContext.SourceString: 那么，为什么我的蛛网感受到了猎物的动静……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Then, why does my spider web sense prey...

TextContext.SourceString: （潜伏在一旁的绯莎这时才注意到，自己的脚下不知何时踩中了一条纤细的蛛丝——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lurking in the shadows, Fuchsia realizes that she has stepped on a thin thread of spider silk...)

TextContext.SourceString: 没打中吗？真厉害啊，鲨鱼姐姐。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I missed? Impressive, shark girl.

TextContext.SourceString: 别在我耳边开枪啊，都快被你震聋了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Don't shoot next to me! You're going to make me deaf!

TextContext.SourceString: （在捂着耳朵的拉法身边，朱利安的手中不知何时端起了一把不知型号的大型狙击步枪。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Standing next to Rafa, who is covering her ears, Julian has somehow produced a large sniper rifle of an unknown model.)

TextContext.SourceString: 你，也是猎人吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Are you a hunter as well?

TextContext.SourceString: （从阴影中现身的绯莎看起来并无大碍，短暂的休息已经让她恢复了正常的运动能力。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Emerging from the shadows, Fuchsia appears fine, having restored her mobility after a brief rest.)

TextContext.SourceString: 猎人这个词听起来太野蛮了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: “Hunter”? That's a bit barbaric, don't you think?

TextContext.SourceString: 比起杀死猎物，我更喜欢看他们活着挣扎的样子。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Rather than killing my prey, I prefer watching them struggle.

TextContext.SourceString: 你也来挣扎看看吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Why don't you struggle a bit for me?

TextContext.SourceString: 居然敢一个人追上来……也太看不起人了吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You've come all by yourself... Don't you think you've slightly underestimated us?

TextContext.SourceString: 对付你们，我一个人就够了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I can handle both of you just fine.

TextContext.SourceString: （我和星绘正躲在远处观察着绯莎与新伯利恒的战斗。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Hiding in the distance, Astierred and I observe the fight between Fuchsia and New Bethlehem.)

TextContext.SourceString: （在狭窄的室内环境下，绯莎强大的感知能力带来了巨大的优势。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (In the confined space, Fuchsia's strong sensory abilities give her the upper hand.)

TextContext.SourceString: （在层层叠叠的高大货柜之间来回穿行，不断从出其不意的角度进行奇袭。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Maneuvering between stacks of shipping containers, she constantly launches surprise attacks from unexpected angles.)

TextContext.SourceString: （另一边，拉法与少年虽然占有人数优势，却毫无配合。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (On the other side, although Rafa and Giuliano have the numerical advantage, their teamwork is practically nonexistent.)

TextContext.SourceString: 把掩体全部冲毁……看你能躲到什么时候！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm going to destroy all the covers... You won't be able to hide for long!

TextContext.SourceString: 拉法姐——你把我的蛛丝也毁了，这样我就抓不住她的位置了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Rafa! You've destroyed my spider silk, too! I don't get a fix on her position now!

TextContext.SourceString: （从战况来看，就算是以一敌二，绯莎说不定也有胜算。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Judging by the situation, Fuchsia may stand a chance against the duo.)

TextContext.SourceString: （但随着周围的货柜不断被拉法的能力腐蚀、破坏，绯莎的活动空间也被逐渐压缩，最终必然迎来不得不与两人正面对敌的一刻。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (But as the surrounding containers are corroded and destroyed by Rafa, Fuchsia has less and less space to maneuver. Eventually, she will have to face the pair head-on.)

TextContext.SourceString: 前辈，绯莎小姐真的没问题吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Is Miss Fuchsia going to be fine, Navigator?

TextContext.SourceString: 现在只能相信她了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Let's pray that she will.

TextContext.SourceString: 别分心，做好准备。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Don't be distracted. Get ready.

TextContext.SourceString: （又是一次视角之外的奇袭，拉法立即向射击的方向反击，却再一次扑了个空。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As Fuchsia launches another surprise attack, Rafa immediately fires in the direction of the shot only to miss again.)

TextContext.SourceString: （与拉法不同，朱利安将枪口指向了另一个完全不同的方向……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Unlike Rafa, Giuliano takes aim in a completely different direction...)

TextContext.SourceString: ……就算没有蛛丝，我也差不多摸透你的思考了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...Even without the spider silk, I've seen through your tricks.

TextContext.SourceString: （下一刻，绯莎的身影如预期般出现在了朱利安的瞄准线上。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As expected, Fuchsia appears right in front of Giuliano's crosshair.)

TextContext.SourceString: （绯莎正向着朱利安的方向冲刺。来不及躲避——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Fuchsia sprints toward Julian as she has no time to dodge...)

TextContext.SourceString: （齿锋在绯莎的手中喷吐着火焰，试图赶在朱利安扣动扳机之前将他打倒。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Wielding the flame-spitting Sawtooth, Fuchsia attempts to take down Giuliano before he can pull the trigger.)

TextContext.SourceString: （还差一点，还不够近！还不够准！）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Almost there! Not close enough! Not accurate enough!)

TextContext.SourceString: （沉闷的枪声响起，朱利安的子弹瞄准着绯莎的眉心飞去。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (With a muffled gunshot sound, Giuliano's bullet flies toward Fuchsia's head.)

TextContext.SourceString: （绯莎敏锐的感官几乎捕捉到了子弹的轨迹……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (With her sharp senses, Fuchsia almost catches the trajectory of the bullet...)

TextContext.SourceString: （我做的到吗？像那个少女那样……不行！会输！要避开！）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Can I do it? Like her... No way! I'll lose! I have to dodge it!)

TextContext.SourceString: 相信我！！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Trust me!

TextContext.SourceString: 就这么冲过去！！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Charge!
...Tsk.

TextContext.SourceString: （听到我的喊声的瞬间，绯莎放弃了回避的想法，迎着子弹继续飞驰——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Having heard my shout, Fuchsia gives up on trying to dodge and keep charging at the bullet.)

TextContext.SourceString: 去吧——守护星芒！！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Go, Guardian Star!

TextContext.SourceString: （在绯莎发动突击的同时，使用星绘的弦能力形成护甲弹开子弹，为绯莎创造接近敌人的机会，这就是我们原本的作战计划。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As Fuchsia launches her assault, Astierred forms a shield using her string ability to deflect the bullet, creating a window of opportunity for Fuchsia to get close to the enemy - our initial plan.)

TextContext.SourceString: （机会只有一次，所以——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (We only have one chance, so...)

TextContext.SourceString: 检测到危机情景。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Crisis detected.

TextContext.SourceString: 演算机能，启动。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Calculation function activated.

TextContext.SourceString: （手环呼应着我的想法，亮起了蓝色的辉光。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Responding to my thought, the bracelet glows with a blue light.)

TextContext.SourceString: （庞大的信息流瞬间流入脑海。和在格罗夫银行时一样，但更为清晰……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A vast stream of information instantly floods my mind. Just like back at Grove Bank, only clearer...)

TextContext.SourceString: （无数的画面在眼前飞过，无数的分支，无数的选择……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I see before my eyes countless scenarios; countless branches; countless choices...)
(However...)

TextContext.SourceString: （不对——这些都不对！不对！不对！不对！）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (No! None of this is right. It's all wrong! Wrong!)

TextContext.SourceString: （星绘没能挡住子弹，绯莎被打败，奥黛丽被新伯利恒带走……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Astierred has failed to stop the bullet, resulting in Fuchsia being defeated and New Bethlehem taking away Audrey...)

TextContext.SourceString: （为什么！为什么所有的分支都通向了失败的结局！？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Why? Why do all branches lead to failure?!)

TextContext.SourceString: （不断寻找，不断思考，不断将眼前的画面拨开。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Searching, thinking, I expand the scenarios.)

TextContext.SourceString: （这时，在某个画面的角落里我看见了——绯莎的衣服上沾上了拉法所射出的腐蚀性液体。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (In the corner of an image, I notice that Fuchsia's clothes are stained with the corrosive liquid shot by Rafa.)

TextContext.SourceString: （那个能力，会与星绘的能力互相中和、抵消……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The liquid neutralizes Celestia's ability, rendering it useless.)

TextContext.SourceString: （失算了……吗？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Was I wrong?)

TextContext.SourceString: （失败了……吗？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Have we failed?)

TextContext.SourceString: 不要停下，不要放弃，你和“她”应该还有着更强大的力量才对……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Do not stop. Do not despair, for there is a greater power between you and her...

TextContext.SourceString: 思念的牵绊，拥有跨越时空的力量——
TextContext.LocalizedString: The bond of longing transcends time and space...

TextContext.SourceString: （又一次，见到了这片令人有些怀念的星空。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Once again, I see the familiar starry sky.)

TextContext.SourceString: （但不同的是，我的身边有着星绘的身影。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Only this time, Astierred is next to me.)

TextContext.SourceString: （一种难以描述的感觉将我和星绘连接在了一起。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (An indescribable feeling connects us.)

TextContext.SourceString: （在我们心意相通的那一刻，眼前的星空突然拥有了意义。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As our thoughts become one, the starry sky gains great meaning.)

TextContext.SourceString: （仿佛那不再是星空，而是我们所身处的战场。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As if it is no longer the sky but the battlefield we are in.)

TextContext.SourceString: （不需要语言，我和星绘双目对视，然后同时伸出手，触摸了那个绯红色的光点。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Words are not necessary as Celestia and I lock eyes. We reach out at the same time to the crimson light.)

TextContext.SourceString: 传递我们的思念吧——星空之门！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Pass on our emotions, Astral Gate!

TextContext.SourceString: （朱利安的枪弹向着绯莎直射而去，在那一瞬间——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As Julian's bullet flies toward Fuchsia...)

TextContext.SourceString: （伴随着闪耀的星芒，星绘从撕裂的空间裂隙之中现身。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Amidst sparkling starlight, Celestia appears from a torn spatial rift.)

TextContext.SourceString: （扭曲空间的力场包裹着星绘和绯莎，将袭击而来的攻击尽数弹开。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The distorted force envelops Celestia and Fuchsia, deflecting all incoming attacks.)

TextContext.SourceString: ——什么？空间跳跃！？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What? Spatial jump!

TextContext.SourceString: 她有这种能力吗！？
TextContext.LocalizedString: How is she capable of that?

TextContext.SourceString: （虽然和事先听说的情报不太相同，但绯莎对星绘的帮助早有预料，她没有错过这个间隙，将弹匣中的所有子弹向着敌人倾泻。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Although it is not as exactly as the intel suggested, Fuchsia has anticipated Celestia's help. She seizes the opportunity and fires everything she has at the enemy.)

TextContext.SourceString: （局势瞬间逆转，被绯莎的火力重创的两人，捂着伤口向后撤退。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The battle takes a drastic turn. Wounded by Fuchsia's heavy firepower, the duo attempts to retreat.)

TextContext.SourceString: 没有人能逃脱狩猎！
TextContext.LocalizedString: None shall escape from the hunt!

TextContext.SourceString: （绯莎的力量再一次迸发，如同离弦之箭向两人射去。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Fuchsia once again bursts with power, dashing toward the two like a fleeting arrow.)

TextContext.SourceString: （在最近的距离，用最准确的射击，将枪口抵上猎物的喉咙——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (At close range, with precise aim, she presses her gun to the prey's throat...)
What?

TextContext.SourceString: （绯莎的枪口被一只手稳稳地捏住，偏离了目标。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Someone firmly grasps the muzzle of Fuchsia's gun, causing her to miss.)

TextContext.SourceString: 今天就到此为止吧，小鲨鱼？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Shall we call it a day, shark girl?

TextContext.SourceString: （被星空之门传送的不只星绘一个人。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The Astral Gate teleported more than just Celestia.)

TextContext.SourceString: （我也和星绘一样来到了战场之中。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Celestia and I have also arrived on the battlefield.)

TextContext.SourceString: （在星绘和绯莎与新伯利恒交战时，我趁机跑向了奥黛丽所在的位置。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As Celestia and Fuchsia fight New Bethlehem, I seize the opportunity and run toward Audrey.)

TextContext.SourceString: （奥黛丽的崩溃症症状正在加剧，必须立刻进行治疗，一刻也不能耽误。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Audrey's collapse syndrome symptoms are worsening. She needs immediate medical attention.)

TextContext.SourceString: （被蛛网所束缚的奥黛丽就在我眼前。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Bound by the spider web, Audrey lies right in front of me.)

TextContext.SourceString: （她身上出现的蓝色裂痕显示着——她的崩溃症已经发展至中期，离无可挽回的精神崩溃只剩一步之遥。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The blue cracks on her body indicate that her collapse syndrome has progressed to the mid-stage. She is steps away from an irreversible mental breakdown.)

TextContext.SourceString: 奥黛丽，醒醒！！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Wake up, Audrey!

TextContext.SourceString: （奥黛丽的身体状态没有大碍，问题果然还是在于精神层面。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Audrey's physical condition appears unharmed. The problem lies within her mind.)

TextContext.SourceString: （根据过往的治疗经验，想要稳定崩溃症患者的精神，必须找到帮助他稳定精神的“锚点”。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Based on my experience, in order to stabilize the mind of a collapse syndrome patient, their anchor point must be located.)

TextContext.SourceString: 拨开蛛网
TextContext.LocalizedString: Clear the spider web

TextContext.SourceString: （清理蛛网的过程中，奥黛丽的怀中掉出了一件不太寻常的物品——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As I clear the spider web, an unusual item falls from Audrey's clothes.)

TextContext.SourceString: （那是一本在现代已不多见的，纸质的日记本。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A paperback diary, a rarity in the modern world.)

TextContext.SourceString: 拿起日记本
TextContext.LocalizedString: Pick up the diary

TextContext.SourceString: （就在这时，手环发出了光亮。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (My bracelet suddenly starts glowing.)

TextContext.SourceString: （温柔的光芒将我和奥黛丽一起包围。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The gentle light envelops Audrey and me.)

TextContext.SourceString: （我感到了一股熟悉的连接感……就和刚才与星绘同在的那片星空一样。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I feel a familiar sense of connection... just like the starry sky I was under with Astierred.)

TextContext.SourceString: （这里是……奥黛丽的世界。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (This is... Audrey's world.)

TextContext.SourceString: （存在于眼前的是一座高悬于螺旋楼梯上的囚笼。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I see a cage suspended above a spiral staircase.)

TextContext.SourceString: （而奥黛丽，正孤单地蹲坐在囚笼之中。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Audrey is sitting in the cage alone.)

TextContext.SourceString: 走上楼梯
TextContext.LocalizedString: Walk up the stairs

TextContext.SourceString: （螺旋而上的阶梯发出了吱吱嘎嘎的声音，似乎随时都会断裂。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The stairs creak as I walk on them as if they might break at any moment.)

TextContext.SourceString: （属于奥黛丽的回忆，一边走一边在阶梯四周浮现。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I see all around me memories belonging to Audrey.)

TextContext.SourceString: （从“崩溃症”中苏醒的奥黛丽，完全不是“奥黛丽”的奥黛丽，重新认识世界的“奥黛丽”。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (An Audrey that has just awoken from collapse syndrome. An Audrey that is no Audrey at all. An Audrey who has just started reacquainting herself with the world.)

TextContext.SourceString: （为了联盟，为了家族，为了那些原本不属于“她”的责任拼尽全力。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (For the alliance; for her family; she exhausts herself for responsibilities that were not hers.)

TextContext.SourceString: （眼前的“她”是为了扮演“奥黛丽”而将自己封闭起来的少女。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The caged girl has jailed herself trying to become Audrey.)

TextContext.SourceString: （我不自觉地加快了脚步，来到了囚禁着少女的牢笼之前。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Quickening my pace, I arrive at the cage.)

TextContext.SourceString: 我还是让人失望了吧……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I've disappointed people again, haven't I...

TextContext.SourceString: 急功近利，轻信他人，最后重蹈覆辙。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hasty for success. Trusting those who should not be trusted. Only to repeat the same mistakes.

TextContext.SourceString: 迎来这样的结局也是理所当然的吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's only natural for me to end up this way.

TextContext.SourceString: 毕竟我……并不是“奥黛丽”……
TextContext.LocalizedString: After all... I am not Audrey...

TextContext.SourceString: 我就像是一个把她的人生偷走的小偷……做着不属于自己的公主梦……幻想自己能成为故事中的女主角……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm a thief who stole her life... In a dream that is not mine... Fantasizing about becoming the heroine in someone else's story...

TextContext.SourceString: 但我不是“奥黛丽·格罗夫”，我成为不了“钢铁的独角兽”……
TextContext.LocalizedString: But I am not Audrey Grove. I am not The Steel Unicorn...

TextContext.SourceString: 我只是一个就算消失也没有人会在意的小丑罢了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I am nothing but a clown. No one would care if I were to just disappear...

TextContext.SourceString: 反正，还会有下一个“奥黛丽”来代替我……
TextContext.LocalizedString: After all, I'll just be replaced with another Audrey...

TextContext.SourceString: 我不同意！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I disagree!

TextContext.SourceString: （我竭尽全力的话语似乎并没有传到奥黛丽的耳中。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Audrey does not seem to hear my shout.)

TextContext.SourceString: （她依旧保持着原本的姿势，在牢笼中枯坐。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (She remains sitting desolately in her cage.)

TextContext.SourceString: （帮助星庇所的你、和我们立下约定的你——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The person who helped Astral Sanctuary and made a pact with us...)

TextContext.SourceString: （不是“钢铁的独角兽”，而是现在的你，真正的你——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Was not The Steel Unicorn, but you. The real you!)

TextContext.SourceString: （想要告诉你，想要传达到——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I want to tell you everything...)

TextContext.SourceString: （将所有这些没能说出的话语化为力量——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Turning my unspoken words into strength...)

TextContext.SourceString: （打破牢笼）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Break the cage)

TextContext.SourceString: （贫弱的肉体撞上钢铁，发出沉闷的响声。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (My feeble body hits the steel cage, producing a dull thud.)

TextContext.SourceString: （扯碎锁链）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Tear apart the chains)

TextContext.SourceString: （牢笼依然坚固如旧，但奥黛丽终于听到了我作出的这许多声响。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The cage stands strong, but Audrey has finally heard the noises.)

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者……你怎么会……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Navigator... What are you doing...

TextContext.SourceString: 因为我答应过你——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Because I made you a promise!

TextContext.SourceString: 我绝不放弃任何一个患者！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm not giving up on any patient!

TextContext.SourceString: 是啊……的确有过那样的约定……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yes... You did promise me that...

TextContext.SourceString: 所以轮到你遵守约定了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's time for you to fulfill your part!

TextContext.SourceString: 说要拜访星庇所的约定你忘记了吗！
TextContext.LocalizedString: You promised that you would visit Astral Sanctuary!

TextContext.SourceString: 我只是个冒牌货，我没有那种资格……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm just an impostor. It's not my right to do that...

TextContext.SourceString: 才不是什么冒牌货！
TextContext.LocalizedString: You are no impostor!

TextContext.SourceString: 我认识的只有现在的奥黛丽！
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're the only Audrey I have ever known!

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者……我……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Navigator... I...

TextContext.SourceString: 把手给我！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Give me your hand!

TextContext.SourceString: 我们一起回去！
TextContext.LocalizedString: We'll go back together!

TextContext.SourceString: 哈哈……呵，搞什么啊？说这种像童话一样的台词？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ha-ha... What are you doing? Are we in a fairy tale play?

TextContext.SourceString: 在童话故事里……唤醒公主的人，可是要负起责任的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: In a fairy tale... The person who awakens the princess has to take responsibility.

TextContext.SourceString: （奥黛丽伸出了手，而我握住了她。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I grab Audrey's extended hand.)

TextContext.SourceString: （奥黛丽的双腿重新找回了力量，她的眼神重新散发出光彩。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Audrey's legs regain strength. Her eyes once again shine with light.)

TextContext.SourceString: （没错，这才是我认识的奥黛丽。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (That's right. This is the Audrey I know.)

TextContext.SourceString: （——永远昂首傲视的高贵的独角兽。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The forever proud and noble unicorn.)

TextContext.SourceString: （比世上任何东西都更坚固的心之牢笼缓缓地开裂，周围的一切开始崩塌。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The heart's cage, which is stronger than anything else in the world, slowly cracks as the surroundings start to collapse.)

TextContext.SourceString: （与此同时，现实的感官开始逐渐恢复。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (At the same time, I regain my senses.)

TextContext.SourceString: （在朦胧的意识之中，一种冲动油然而生——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (While my consciousness is still blurry, I feel a sudden impulse...)

TextContext.SourceString: （撕碎日记）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Tear up the diary)

TextContext.SourceString: （经历了漫长的一瞬间，脑海中这个突如其来的念头连我自己都感到不解。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (After a prolonged moment, I feel puzzled by this sudden thought.)

TextContext.SourceString: （理应成为奥黛丽稳定崩溃症的“锚点”的这本日记，如果将其破坏，究竟会带来怎样的结果？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The diary is supposed to be the anchor point for treating Audrey's collapse syndrome. What consequences will there be if it is destroyed?

TextContext.SourceString: （在我自己产生疑问之前，手中的日记已经被撕成了碎片。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Before I have time to doubt myself, the diary has already been torn to pieces.)

TextContext.SourceString: （而奥黛丽——缓缓睁开了双眼，那双眼之中有着清澈的意志。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Audrey slowly opens her eyes, within which lies a clear will.)

TextContext.SourceString: 引、航……者？
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...N-Navigator?

TextContext.SourceString: 你没事吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Are you alright?

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，身体还能动……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yes, I can move...

TextContext.SourceString: 你认得我吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Do you know who I am?

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，意识还很清晰……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Mm-hmm, my mind is sound...

TextContext.SourceString: 奇怪，崩溃症的影响似乎消失了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Weird. The symptoms of collapse syndrome are gone.

TextContext.SourceString: （正如奥黛丽所言，原本遍布奥黛丽全身的裂痕竟然出现了消退的迹象。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As Audrey has said, the cracks all over her body begin to fade.)

TextContext.SourceString: （理应不可治愈的崩溃症……这已经超出了意识修复疗法的理论范畴。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Collapse syndrome is theoretically incurable... This is beyond consciousness restoration therapy.)

TextContext.SourceString: （这种现象即使在星庇所的病例档案中也从未见过。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Such a phenomenon has never been observed on any of Astral Sanctuary's patients.)

TextContext.SourceString: 什么人！？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Who's there?

TextContext.SourceString: ……“主人公唤醒了沉睡的公主，用奇迹的力量治愈了诅咒”。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...“The protagonist awakens the sleeping princess, healing the curse with the power of miracles.”

TextContext.SourceString: 真是一出好剧啊……我猜，接下来的剧情就该讨伐施加诅咒的巫婆了吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What a great play... Up next, you're going to defeat the witch who cast the curse, right?

TextContext.SourceString: 该说初次见面吗？我就是本次出演巫婆的“大艺术家”。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Nice to meet you, I guess? I am The Great Artist playing the witch.

TextContext.SourceString: 纽特朗爆炸案、格罗夫银行……还有寄给你的那封信以及白氏集团的丑闻……
TextContext.LocalizedString: The Neutroville explosions, Grove Bank... the letter you received, and the Bai Group scandal...

TextContext.SourceString: 这些全部——都是我的剧本。怎么了？不攻过来吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: I wrote the scripts for all those events. What's the matter? Aren't you going to attack?

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者，小心！那个人很危险——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Be careful, Navigator. She's dangerous!

TextContext.SourceString: 老实点。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Shut up.

TextContext.SourceString: （向星绘发出声音的方向望去——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I look toward the direction of Astierred's voice.)

TextContext.SourceString: （一片狼藉的战场中，星绘和绯莎已被除去武器，被新伯利恒的两人当作人质。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (In the devastated battlefield, Celestia and Fuchsia have been disarmed and taken as hostages by the New Bethlehem duo.)

TextContext.SourceString: （这个人，一个人扭转了刚才的劣势吗？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Did she single-handedly turn the tide of the battle?)

TextContext.SourceString: 太卑鄙了，新伯利恒！
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're despicable, New Bethlehem!

TextContext.SourceString: 真伤心啊……我们不是最好的朋友吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: That hurt... Aren't we best friends?

TextContext.SourceString: 你说什么？你……认识我？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What are you talking about? Do you... know me?

TextContext.SourceString: ……不，是我认错了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...No, I was mistaken.

TextContext.SourceString: 奥黛丽·格罗夫，让我再问一次——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Let me ask you again, Audrey Grove...

TextContext.SourceString: 过来这边吧，和我一起，以你的意志……重新塑造这个世界。如何？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Come over. Join me and reshape this world with your will. How's that sound?

TextContext.SourceString: 你真是……擅长鼓动人心啊。但，我拒绝。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're... quite good at encouraging others. However, that's a hard pass from me.

TextContext.SourceString: 将不平等的交易强加于人的新伯利恒，绝对无法与乌尔比诺相容。
TextContext.LocalizedString: New Bethlehem forces unequal deals on people. You can never coexist with Urbino.

TextContext.SourceString: 说的也是啊……
TextContext.LocalizedString: You have a valid point...

TextContext.SourceString: （在奥黛丽身后的阴影中，另一个“大艺术家”优雅地举起了手中的步枪。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Lurking in the shadows behind Audrey, another Great Artist elegantly raises her rifle.)

TextContext.SourceString: 小心！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Watch out!

TextContext.SourceString: （急促的枪声响起，应声倒地的是——“大艺术家”所塑造的分身。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (With a sudden gunshot, the clone of The Great Artist falls.)

TextContext.SourceString: 消失吧，赝品。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Disappear, fake.

TextContext.SourceString: （芙拉薇娅的声音从天而降，伴随着天窗中洒落的月光轻巧地落在数米高的货柜上。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Descending from the roof, Flavia gracefully lands atop a stacked shipping container along with the moonlight shining through the skylight.)

TextContext.SourceString: ……竟然将我倾注爱意的杰作叫作赝品，那么你又算什么呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...How dare you refer to my masterpiece as a fake. What does that make you, then?

TextContext.SourceString: （“大艺术家”单手握持着步枪，以舞蹈一般的动作织出了优雅且难以预测的弹幕。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Holding a rifle in one hand, The Great Artist fires an elegant yet unpredictable barrage of bullets as if she is dancing.)

TextContext.SourceString: （两人之间的交锋，如同花与蝶的舞蹈，在月光下闪转腾挪。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Shifting and dodging, they fight under the moonlight like a dance between a flower and a butterfly.)

TextContext.SourceString: 传闻中的“复眼”吗……别忘了我们这边还有人质……！？
TextContext.LocalizedString: The fabled Compound Eye... Don't you forget - we've still got hostages...

TextContext.SourceString: （近乎出于狙击手直觉的反应，朱利安推开了身边的拉法，子弹以毫厘之差掠过了拉法的发丝。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Out of his instinct as a sniper, Julian pushes Rafa aside as the bullet misses her head by inches.)

TextContext.SourceString: 欧泊的狙击手……麻烦起来了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: PUS sniper... This is getting out of hand.

TextContext.SourceString: 星绘！你没事吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Celestia! Are you alright?

TextContext.SourceString: 怎么我一不在你就又钻进麻烦的事里了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Why do you keep getting yourself in trouble when I'm away?

TextContext.SourceString: 拉法……又是你！还想尝尝本搜查官的铁拳吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's you again, Rafa! Have you missed the taste of my fists?

TextContext.SourceString: 臭小鬼！上次是你运气好！
TextContext.LocalizedString: You insolent brat! You got lucky last time!

TextContext.SourceString: （芙拉薇娅和搜查一队的支援令战斗的天平逐渐倾斜。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The arrival of Flavia and the Sentinel Bureau squad tips the balance.)

TextContext.SourceString: （重整态势的星绘和绯莎也趁着交火的间隙向我和奥黛丽的方向靠拢。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Having recovered their strength, Astierred and Fuchsia move closer to Audrey and me amidst the gunfire.)

TextContext.SourceString: 不请自来的观众未免太多了，今天的演出就到此为止吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Too many unwanted guests have shown up. I'm afraid that the show has to end here.

TextContext.SourceString: 喂！要撤退吗？那启示者的计划要怎么办？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hey! Are we retreating? What about the Revelator's plan?

TextContext.SourceString: 别担心，我想到了一个更有趣的主意……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Don't worry. I've got a more interesting idea in mind...

TextContext.SourceString: 朱利安——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Giuliano...

TextContext.SourceString: 我知道。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I know.

TextContext.SourceString: （得到命令的朱利安，从怀中掏出了一枚投掷物——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Having received an order, Julian produces a throwing object)

TextContext.SourceString: ——引航者，闭上眼！！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Close your eyes, Navigator!

TextContext.SourceString: （强烈的耳鸣和目眩令人头疼欲裂。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The intense ringing in my ears and dizziness give me a splitting headache.)

TextContext.SourceString: （脚步声在走远，新伯利恒一定趁这个机会撤退了吧。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The footsteps are receding. New Bethlehem must have seized the opportunity to retreat.)

TextContext.SourceString: （但是在那之前，我还有必须问清楚的事情——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Before they get away, there is one thing I must ask them.)

TextContext.SourceString: 这一切到底是为了什么！？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Why have you done all this?

TextContext.SourceString: 新伯利恒到底有什么目的！？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What does New Bethlehem want?

TextContext.SourceString: 你不是早就知道了吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Don't you know the answer already?

TextContext.SourceString: 一切都是为了“伟大的觉醒”——在那之前，就请你替我们保管好“手杖”了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's all for The Great Awakening. Until then, please take care of the “staff” for us.

TextContext.SourceString: 我等新伯利恒才是将世界导向正确方向之人。
TextContext.LocalizedString: New Bethlehem shall guide the world in the right direction.

TextContext.SourceString: 再会了，引航者。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Farewell, Navigator.

TextContext.SourceString: （——在那之后的某日。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A few days after the battle.)

TextContext.SourceString: （经历了那场与新伯利恒的战斗之后，星庇所又回到了日常的运营之中。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (After the battle with New Bethlehem, Astral Sanctuary has resumed usual operations.)

TextContext.SourceString: （不同的是，现在的星庇所住进了一位特殊的客人。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The only difference is that a special guest is staying here.)

TextContext.SourceString: 奥黛丽小姐，我们进来了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: We're coming in, Lady Audrey.

TextContext.SourceString: （一缕晨光穿透窗纱照在了病床上，温柔地覆盖在金发的少女身上。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A ray of morning light shines through the curtain, gently covering the blonde girl on the bed.)

TextContext.SourceString: （尚未完全消退的伤痕提醒着她——记住那场与新伯利恒以及与她自己的战斗。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Her unhealed wounds serve as a reminder of the battle with New Bethlehem and herself.)

TextContext.SourceString: （在我和星绘进来之后，她收回了看向窗外的目光，露出了温柔的笑容。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As Astierred and I enter the room, she turns her head away from the window, smiling at us.)

TextContext.SourceString: 早上好，“医生”。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Good morning, Doctor.

TextContext.SourceString: 太见外了吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I thought we were all on a first-name basis?

TextContext.SourceString: 你都有力气开玩笑了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Look at you. Joking and all that.

TextContext.SourceString: 拜访星庇所的约定，这样就算完成了吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Does this fulfill my promise to visit Astral Sanctuary?

TextContext.SourceString: 如果不是这种形式的话就更好了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I wish you'd be here under different circumstances.

TextContext.SourceString: 呵呵……也没什么不好吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Heh... This is not too bad.

TextContext.SourceString: 身为星庇所的投资者，这不是最好的考察方式吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: As your investor, I think this is the best way to inspect your facilities.

TextContext.SourceString: 要是不好好把我治好，可就没人给你们投资了哦？
TextContext.LocalizedString: If you don't cure me, you're going to lose your big investor.

TextContext.SourceString: 就算不这么说也会治好你。
TextContext.LocalizedString: We'd fix you up either way.

TextContext.SourceString: 你的“投资”一定会有回报的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Your investment will earn its return.

TextContext.SourceString: 总感觉……奥黛丽小姐好像和之前不太一样了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: I can't help but feel like... you seem different than before, Lady Audrey.

TextContext.SourceString: 是吗？我倒没什么自觉……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Is that so? I haven't noticed...

TextContext.SourceString: 以前的奥黛丽小姐，总是心事重重，说话也很严厉……啊，我没有别的意思！
TextContext.LocalizedString: You always seemed troubled and spoke sternly... Oh. Don't get me wrong!

TextContext.SourceString: 只是，现在的奥黛丽小姐，总感觉放松了很多，这对崩溃症的治疗也是很有帮助的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's just that you seem more relaxed now. This, in turn, will benefit the treatment of collapse syndrome.

TextContext.SourceString: 崩溃症的痕迹已经几乎看不到了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I can't hardly notice any traces of collapse syndrome.

TextContext.SourceString: 难以想象是之前还说要自己消失的人。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's hard to believe you're the same girl who was ready to disappear.

TextContext.SourceString: 是啊……从那么严重的急性崩溃症中恢复，简直就是奇迹。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Right... It was a miracle for you to recover from acute collapse syndrome.

TextContext.SourceString: 前辈那时候到底做了什么？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What did you do back then, Navigator?

TextContext.SourceString: 可以保密吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: I would like to keep that secret.

TextContext.SourceString: （虽然那时候的记忆还隐约留在脑海之中……但现在想起来实在是说了太多让人害羞的台词。这件事还是暂且保密吧。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (While memories of the event still linger in my mind... I did say a lot of embarrassing things. I should keep it a secret for now.)

TextContext.SourceString: 我也说不清……
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's hard to explain...

TextContext.SourceString: （虽然那时候的记忆还隐约留在脑海之中……但无法解释以理论解释的疑点实在太多了。实在无法作为疗法的参考……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (While memories of the event still linger in my mind... there are too many questions that cannot be explained by logic. The experience cannot serve as a reference for her treatment...)

TextContext.SourceString: 呵呵……的确不好说啊……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Heh... Indeed, it's hard to explain...

TextContext.SourceString: 对不起，引航者。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Forgive me, Navigator.

TextContext.SourceString: 怎么了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What is it?

TextContext.SourceString: 什么事？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What do you mean?

TextContext.SourceString: 那本日记里，原本可能记载着与新伯利恒和手环有关的事情……你也很想知道吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: The diary might have contained information related to New Bethlehem and the bracelet... You must be curious.

TextContext.SourceString: 你该不会是为了这个才……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Is that why you...

TextContext.SourceString: 呵呵，结果什么也没弄明白，可能永远都弄不明白了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Heh. In the end, we managed to figure out nothing. We may never know.

TextContext.SourceString: 和拯救患者比起来不算什么。
TextContext.LocalizedString: That's nothing compared to saving a patient.

TextContext.SourceString: 真像你会说的话……
TextContext.LocalizedString: That's exactly something you would say...

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者……你和奥黛丽小姐什么时候有这么多小秘密了？我都听不懂你们在说什么……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Navigator... since when did you and Audrey have so many secrets between you? I have no idea what you're talking about...

TextContext.SourceString: （我想尽办法在能说明白的范围内向星绘进行着解释。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I need to try my best to explain what I understand to Astierred.)

TextContext.SourceString: （而奥黛丽微笑着看了一会，然后重新将视线投向了窗外。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Audrey smiles as she watches Astierred and me before turning her gaze back at the window.)

TextContext.SourceString: （也许是我的错觉，窗外似乎闪过了一个绯红色的影子……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Perhaps I am seeing things, but I seem to have caught a glimpse of a crimson figure flickering across the window...)

TextContext.SourceString: 哟，你来了？等你很久了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're here. I've been waiting for you.

TextContext.SourceString: 很吵，我可以把音响关了吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's too loud. May I turn off the speaker?

TextContext.SourceString: 别……啊，你已经关了啊……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Don't... Oh, you turned it off already...

TextContext.SourceString: 任务怎么样了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: How did the mission go?

TextContext.SourceString: 结论是——“白”。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The conclusion: the light side.

TextContext.SourceString: 现在的奥黛丽·格罗夫与新伯利恒毫无瓜葛。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The current Audrey Grove is not associated with New Bethlehem.

TextContext.SourceString: 是吗？辛苦你了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Is that so? Thank you.

TextContext.SourceString: 不过，既然排除了格罗夫集团……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Nonetheless, now that we have ruled out Grove Enterprises...

TextContext.SourceString: 那么泄露那些丑闻的就另有其人。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Someone else must have been the source of the leak.

TextContext.SourceString: 看来，他们的渗透比我想的还深……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Looks like their infiltration is deeper than I imagined...

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者说得对，这场游戏要更多人玩才有意思。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The Navigator is right. The game is more interesting with additional players.

TextContext.SourceString: 在下一个任务之前，你就先潜伏一阵子吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Stay off the radar for a while until the next mission.

TextContext.SourceString: 怎么了？你还有事吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Is there anything else?

TextContext.SourceString: 老板，我要辞职。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm resigning, boss.

TextContext.SourceString: 哦……啊？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Uh... What?

TextContext.SourceString: 我不是说过会为你准备最好的猎物。你不满意吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: I told you I'd prepare the best prey for you. Are you not satisfied?

TextContext.SourceString: 不，我对老板你没有意见。
TextContext.LocalizedString: No, boss. It's nothing personal.

TextContext.SourceString: 但是——在那个人身边，我可以变得更强、遇到更强的对手。
TextContext.LocalizedString: But by staying with them, I can become stronger and meet more powerful opponents.

TextContext.SourceString: ……引航者吗？呵，那就没办法了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...You're talking about the Navigator. Very well. I won't stop you.

TextContext.SourceString: 不过，辞职就免了，当成是休假吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: However, instead of a resignation, let's treat it as a leave of absence.

TextContext.SourceString: 等到舞台开幕的时候，我还会需要你的力量。
TextContext.LocalizedString: When the curtains rise, I'll still need someone like you...

TextContext.SourceString: （在这间会议室中，依旧摆放着那一天白墨所提出的——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (On a desk in the meeting room, there lies a stack of paper...)

TextContext.SourceString: （关于下一届盟主选举的提案书。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The proposal regarding the next alliance leader election.)

TextContext.SourceString: ……以上就是关于本次事件的报告。抱歉借用了你的队员。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...That concludes the incident report. Please accept my apologies for borrowing your agents.

TextContext.SourceString: （在一段公务性的互相交流后，芙拉薇娅结束了通话。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (After a formal exchange, Flavia hangs up.)

TextContext.SourceString: 条理清晰，主次分明……和心夏前辈的报告完全不一样呢……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Clear, concise, well-organized... Completely different from Kokona's report...

TextContext.SourceString: 米、雪、儿……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Michele...

TextContext.SourceString: 呵呵，那么我就此告辞了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Heh, have a good day.

TextContext.SourceString: 那个，请等一下……！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Sorry! Before you go...

TextContext.SourceString: 芙拉薇娅小姐！刚才报告里提到的——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Miss Flavia! The report mentions...

TextContext.SourceString: 人为诱发崩溃症……真的是可能的吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Induced collapse syndrome... Is that really possible?

TextContext.SourceString: 噢？你注意到了啊？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh, you've noticed.

TextContext.SourceString: 没错，这次的事件就和你父亲——乔治·李的遭遇非常相像，不是吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: This whole incident is quite similar to what your father, George Lee, experienced, don't you think?

TextContext.SourceString: （夜色之下的欧拉港口，枪弹与轰鸣装点了这个夜晚。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Port Euler, the night sky comes alive with the sound of gunfire.)

TextContext.SourceString: （烈焰之中，高贵的独角兽踏着火焰缓步而出。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A noble unicorn gracefully steps out of a sea of fire.)

TextContext.SourceString: （在她的对面，是准备好露出尖牙的猎杀者。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Across from her is a hunter, ready to bare its fangs.)

TextContext.SourceString: 到底是怎么回事，奥黛丽·格罗夫？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What is going on with you, Audrey Grove?

TextContext.SourceString: 现在的你，是乌尔比诺的敌人，还是盟友？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Are you an enemy or an ally of Urbino?

TextContext.SourceString: 视你的回答而定——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Your fate depends on your answer...

TextContext.SourceString: 别、妨碍我——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Don't get in my way...

TextContext.SourceString: 要战吗？那么……
TextContext.LocalizedString: You want to fight? In that case...

TextContext.SourceString: 我来送你上路吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'll put you six feet under!
